are some optimizations that\\\\npipeline\\\\nperforms, for example, when all threads are both producers and consumers, but in general, the cost of supporting all these features cannot be fully eliminated. For example,\\\\npipeline\\\\nstores and uses a set of barriers in shared memory for synchronization, which is not really necessary if all threads in the block participate in the pipeline.\\\\nFor the particular case in which all threads in the block participate in the\\\\npipeline\\\\n, we can do better than\\\\npipeline<thread_scope_block>\\\\nby using a\\\\npipeline<thread_scope_thread>\\\\ncombined with\\\\n__syncthreads()\\\\n:\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\nsize_t\\\\nstages_count\\\\n>\\\\n__global__\\\\nvoid\\\\nwith_staging_scope_thread\\\\n(\\\\nint\\\\n*\\\\nglobal_out\\\\n,\\\\nint\\\\nconst\\\\n*\\\\nglobal_in\\\\n,\\\\nsize_t\\\\nsize\\\\n,\\\\nsize_t\\\\nbatch_sz\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\nauto\\\\ngrid\\\\n=\\\\ncooperative_groups\\\\n::\\\\nthis_grid\\\\n();\\\\nauto\\\\nblock\\\\n=\\\\ncooperative_groups\\\\n::\\\\nthis_thread_block\\\\n();\\\\nauto\\\\nthread\\\\n=\\\\ncooperative_groups\\\\n::\\\\nthis_thread\\\\n();\\\\nassert\\\\n(\\\\nsize\\\\n==\\\\nbatch_sz\\\\n*\\\\ngrid\\\\n.\\\\nsize\\\\n());\\\\n// Assume input size fits batch_sz * grid_size\\\\nextern\\\\n__shared__\\\\nint\\\\nshared\\\\n[];\\\\n// stages_count * block.size() * sizeof(int) bytes\\\\nsize_t\\\\nshared_offset\\\\n[\\\\nstages_count\\\\n];\\\\nfor\\\\n(\\\\nint\\\\ns\\\\n=\\\\n0\\\\n;\\\\ns\\\\n<\\\\nstages_count\\\\n;\\\\n++\\\\ns\\\\n)\\\\nshared\\\\n\\\\n[EXCERPT extracted-character range 496000:504000]\\\\n finished reading shared memory.\\\\n// Create a \\\\\\\"bulk async-group\\\\\\\" out of the previous bulk copy operation.\\\\nptx\\\\n::\\\\ncp_async_bulk_commit_group\\\\n();\\\\n// Wait for the group to have completed reading from shared memory.\\\\nptx\\\\n::\\\\ncp_async_bulk_wait_group_read\\\\n(\\\\nptx\\\\n::\\\\nn32_t\\\\n<\\\\n0\\\\n>\\\\n());\\\\n}\\\\n}\\\\nBarrier initialization\\\\n. The barrier is initialized with the number of\\\\n\\\\nthreads participating in the block. As a result, the barrier will flip only if\\\\n\\\\nall threads have arrived on this barrier. Shared memory barriers are described\\\\n\\\\nin more detail in\\\\nAsynchronous Data Copies using cuda::barrier\\\\n.\\\\n\\\\nTo make the initialized barrier visible to subsequent bulk-asynchronous copies, the\\\\nfence.proxy.async.shared::cta\\\\ninstruction is used. This instruction ensures that\\\\n\\\\nsubsequent bulk-asynchronous copy operations operate on the initialized barrier.\\\\nTMA read\\\\n. The bulk-asynchronous copy instruction directs the\\\\n\\\\nhardware to copy a large chunk of data into shared memory, and to update the\\\\ntransaction count\\\\nof the shared memory barrier after completing the read. In general, issuing as\\\\n\\\\nfew bulk copies with as big a size as possible results in the best performance.\\\\n\\\\nBecause the copy can be performed asynchronously by the hardware, it is not\\\\n\\\\nnecessary to split the copy into smaller chunks.\\\\nThe thread that initiates the bulk-asynchronous copy operation arrives at the barrier\\\\n\\\\nusing\\\\nmbarrier.expect_tx\\\\n. This is automatically performed by\\\\ncuda::memcpy_async\\\\n. This tells the barrier that the thread has\\\\n\\\\narrived and also how many bytes (tx / transactions) are expected to arrive. Only\\\\n\\\\na single thread has to update the expected transaction count. If multiple\\\\n\\\\nthreads update the transaction count, the expected transaction will be the sum\\\\n\\\\nof the updates. The barrier will only flip once all threads have arrived\\\\nand\\\\nall bytes have arrived. Once the barrier has flipped, the bytes are safe to read\\\\n\\\\nfrom shared memory, both by the threads as well as by subsequent\\\\n\\\\nbulk-asynchronous copies. More information about barrier transaction accounting\\\\n\\\\ncan be found in the\\\\nPTX ISA\\\\n.\\\\nBarrier wait\\\\n. Waiting for the barrier to flip is done using\\\\nmbarrier.try_wait\\\\n. It can either return true, indicating that the wait is\\\\n\\\\nover, or return false, which may mean that the wait timed out. The while loop\\\\n\\\\nwaits for completion, and retries on time-out.\\\\nSMEM write and sync\\\\n. The increment of the buffer values reads and writes to shared\\\\n\\\\nmemory. To make the writes visible to subsequent bulk-asynchronous copies, the\\\\nfence.proxy.async.shared::cta\\\\ninstruction is used. This orders the writes to\\\\n\\\\nshared memory before subsequent reads from bulk-asynchronous copy operations,\\\\n\\\\nwhich read through the async proxy. So each thread first orders the writes to\\\\n\\\\nobjects in shared memory in the async proxy via the\\\\nfence.proxy.async.shared::cta\\\\n, and these operations by all threads are\\\\n\\\\nordered before the async operation performed in thread 0 using\\\\n__syncthreads()\\\\n.\\\\nTMA write and sync\\\\n. The write from shared to global memory is again\\\\n\\\\ninitiated by a single thread. The completion of the write is not tracked by a\\\\n\\\\nshared memory barrier. Instead, a thread-local mechanism is used. Multiple\\\\n\\\\nwrites can be batched into a so-called\\\\nbulk async-group\\\\n. Afterwards, the\\\\n\\\\nthread can wait for all operations in this group to have completed reading from\\\\n\\\\nshared memory (as in the code above) or to have completed writing to global\\\\n\\\\nmemory, making the writes visible to the initiating thread. For more information,\\\\n\\\\nrefer to the PTX ISA documentation of\\\\ncp.async.bulk.wait_group\\\\n.\\\\n\\\\nNote that the bulk-asynchronous and non-bulk asynchronous copy instructions have\\\\n\\\\ndifferent async-groups: there exist both\\\\ncp.async.wait_group\\\\nand\\\\ncp.async.bulk.wait_group\\\\ninstructions.\\\\nThe bulk-asynchronous instructions have specific alignment requirements on their source and\\\\n\\\\ndestination addresses. More information can be found in the table below.\\\\nTable 7\\\\nAlignment requirements for one-dimensional bulk-asynchronous operations in Compute Capability 9.0.\\\\n\\\\nAddress / Size\\\\nAlignment\\\\nGlobal memory address\\\\nMust be 16 byte aligned.\\\\nShared memory address\\\\nMust be 16 byte aligned.\\\\nShared memory barrier address\\\\nMust be 8 byte aligned (this is guaranteed by\\\\ncuda::barrier\\\\n).\\\\nSize of transfer\\\\nMust be a multiple of 16 bytes.\\\\n7.29.2.\\\\nUsing TMA to transfer multi-dimensional arrays\\\\n\\\\nThe primary difference between the one-dimensional and multi-dimensional case is\\\\n\\\\nthat a tensor map must be created on the host and passed to the CUDA kernel.\\\\n\\\\nThis section describes how to create a tensor map using the CUDA driver API, how\\\\n\\\\nto pass it to device, and how to use it on device.\\\\nDriver API\\\\n. When the shared memory buffer is not aligned by the number of bytes by which the swizzle pattern repeats itself, there is an offset between the swizzle pattern and the shared memory.\\\\n\\\\nSee\\\\ncomment\\\\n, below.\\\\nInner dimension:\\\\nThe inner dimension of the shared memory block must meet the size requirements specified in table\\\\nTable 10\\\\n. This means that data is organized and accessed in chunks\\\\n\\\\nof 16 bytes, which must be considered when planning memory layout and access patterns.\\\\nSwizzle Pattern Pointer Offset Computation\\\\n. of a Modified Tensor Map\\\\n\\\\nIn contrast to using a tensor map that is passed as a\\\\nconst\\\\n__grid_constant__\\\\nkernel parameter, using a tensor map in\\\\n\\\\nglobal memory requires explicitly establishing a release-acquire pattern in the tensor map proxy between the threads\\\\n\\\\nthat modify the tensor map and the threads that use it.\\\\nThe release part of the pattern was shown in the previous section. It is accomplished using\\\\n\\\\nthe\\\\ncuda::ptx::tensormap.cp_fenceproxy\\\\nfunction.\\\\nThe acquire part is accomplished using the\\\\ncuda::ptx::fence_proxy_tensormap_generic\\\\nfunction that wraps the\\\\nfence.proxy.tensormap::generic.acquire\\\\ninstruction. If the two threads participating in the release-acquire pattern are on the same device, the\\\\n.gpu\\\\nscope suffices. If the threads are on\\\\n\\\\ndifferent devices, the\\\\n.sys\\\\nscope must be used. Once a tensor map has been acquired by one thread, it can be used by other threads in the block\\\\n\\\\nafter sufficient synchronization, for example, using\\\\n__syncthreads()\\\\n. The thread that uses the tensor map and the thread that performs the fence\\\\n\\\\nmust be in the same block. That is, if the threads are in, for example, two different thread blocks of the same cluster, the same grid, or a\\\\n\\\\ndifferent kernel, synchronization APIs such as\\\\ncooperative_groups::cluster\\\\nor\\\\ngrid_group::sync()\\\\nor stream-order synchronization do not\\\\n\\\\nsuffice to establish ordering for tensor map updates, that is, threads in these other thread blocks still need to acquire the tensor map proxy\\\\n\\\\nat the right scope before using the updated tensor map. If there are no intermediate modifications, the fence does not have to be repeated\\\\n\\\\nbefore each\\\\ncp.async.bulk.tensor\\\\ninstruction.\\\\nThe\\\\nfence\\\\nand subsequent use of the tensor map is shown in the following example.\\\\n// Consumer of tensor map in global memory:\\\\n__global__\\\\nvoid\\\\nconsume_tensor_map\\\\n(\\\\nCUtensorMap\\\\n*\\\\ntensor_map\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\n// Fence acquire tensor map:\\\\nptx\\\\n::\\\\nn\\\\n\\\\n[EXCERPT extracted-character range 572000:632000]\\\\nt\\\\nfoo\\\\n()\\\\n{\\\\nint\\\\nvalue\\\\n{\\\\n0\\\\n};\\\\n...\\\\nreturn\\\\nvalue\\\\n;\\\\n}\\\\n__device__\\\\nint\\\\nbar\\\\n()\\\\n{\\\\nint\\\\nvalue\\\\n{\\\\n0\\\\n};\\\\n...\\\\nreturn\\\\nvalue\\\\n;\\\\n}\\\\n__device__\\\\nvoid\\\\nbaz\\\\n()\\\\n{\\\\nint\\\\nresult\\\\n{\\\\n0\\\\n};\\\\nint\\\\n(\\\\n*\\\\nfptr\\\\n)()\\\\n=\\\\nfoo\\\\n;\\\\n// function pointer\\\\n#pragma nv_abi preserve_n_data(16) preserve_n_control(8)\\\\nresult\\\\n=\\\\nfptr\\\\n();\\\\n// The pragma affects the indirect call to foo() via fptr\\\\n#pragma nv_abi preserve_n_data(16) preserve_n_control(8)\\\\nresult\\\\n=\\\\n(\\\\n*\\\\nfptr\\\\n)();\\\\n// Alternate syntax for the indirect call to foo()\\\\n#pragma nv_abi preserve_n_data(16) preserve_n_control(8)\\\\nresult\\\\n+=\\\\nbar\\\\n();\\\\n// The pragma does NOT affect the direct call to bar()\\\\n}\\\\nAs shown in the following example, to modify direct function calls, you must apply the pragma to the function declaration or definition.\\\\n#pragma nv_abi preserve_n_data(16)\\\\n__device__\\\\nvoid\\\\nfoo\\\\n();\\\\nNote that a program is ill-formed if the pragma arguments for a function declaration and its corresponding definition do not match.\\\\n8.\\\\nCooperative Groups\\\\n\\\\n8.1.\\\\nIntroduction\\\\n\\\\nCooperative Groups is an extension to the CUDA programming model, introduced in CUDA 9, for organizing groups of communicating threads. Cooperative Groups allows developers to express the granularity at which threads are communicating, helping them to express richer, more efficient parallel decompositions.\\\\nHistorically, the CUDA programming model has provided a single, simple construct for synchronizing cooperating threads: a barrier across all threads of a thread block, as implemented with the\\\\n__syncthreads()\\\\nintrinsic function. However, programmers would like to define and synchronize groups of threads at other granularities to enable greater performance, design flexibility, and software reuse in the form of “collective” group-wide function interfaces. In an effort to express broader patterns of parallel interaction, many performance-oriented programmers have resorted to writing their own ad hoc and unsafe primitives for synchronizing threads within a single warp, or across sets of thread blocks running on a single GPU. Whilst the performance improvements achieved have often been valuable, this has resulted in an ever-growing collection of brittle code that is expensive to write, tune, and maintain over time and across GPU generations. Cooperative Groups addresses this by providing a safe and future-proof mechanism to enable performant code.\\\\n8.2.\\\\nWhat’s New in Cooperative Groups\\\\n\\\\n8.2.1.\\\\nCUDA 12.2\\\\n\\\\nbarrier_arrive\\\\nand\\\\nbarrier_wait\\\\nmember functions were added for\\\\ngrid_group\\\\nand\\\\nthread_block\\\\n. Description of the API is available\\\\nhere\\\\n.\\\\n8.2.2.\\\\nCUDA 12.1\\\\n\\\\ninvoke_one and invoke_one_broadcast\\\\nAPIs were added.\\\\n8.2.3.\\\\nCUDA 12.0\\\\n\\\\nThe following experimental APIs are now moved to the main namespace:\\\\nasynchronous reduce and scan update added in CUDA 11.7\\\\nthread_block_tile\\\\nlarger than 32 added in CUDA 11.1\\\\nIt is no longer required to provide memory using the\\\\nblock_tile_memory\\\\nobject in order to create these large tiles on Compute Capability 8.0 or higher.\\\\n8.3.\\\\nProgramming Model Concept\\\\n\\\\nThe Cooperative Groups programming model describes synchronization patterns both within and across CUDA thread blocks. It provides both the means for applications to define their own groups of threads, and the interfaces to synchronize them. It also provides new launch APIs that enforce certain restrictions and therefore can guarantee the synchronization will work. These primitives enable new patterns of cooperative parallelism within CUDA, including producer-consumer parallelism, opportunistic parallelism, and global synchronization across the entire Grid.\\\\nThe Cooperative Groups programming model consists of the following elements:\\\\nData types for representing groups of cooperating threads;\\\\nOperations to obtain implicit groups defined by the CUDA launch API (e.g., thread blocks);\\\\nCollectives for partitioning existing groups into new groups;\\\\nCollective Algorithms for data movement and manipulation (e.g. memcpy_async, reduce, scan);\\\\nAn operation to synchronize all threads within the group;\\\\nOperations to inspect the group properties;\\\\nCollectives that expose low-level, group-specific and often HW accelerated, operations.\\\\nThe main concept in Cooperative Groups is that of objects naming the set of threads that are part of it. This expression of groups as first-class program objects improves software composition, since collective functions can receive an explicit object representing the group of participating threads. This object also makes programmer intent explicit, which eliminates unsound architectural assumptions that result in brittle code, undesirable restrictions upon compiler optimizations, and better compatibility with new GPU generations.\\\\nTo write efficient code, its best to use specialized groups (going generic loses a lot of compile time optimizations), and pass these group objects by reference to functions that intend to use these threads in some cooperative fashion.\\\\nCooperative Groups requires CUDA 9.0 or later. To use Cooperative Groups, include the header file:\\\\n// Primary header is compatible with pre-C++11, collective algorithm headers require C++11\\\\n#include\\\\n<cooperative_groups.h>\\\\n// Optionally include for memcpy_async() collective\\\\n#include\\\\n<cooperative_groups/memcpy_async.h>\\\\n// Optionally include for reduce() collective\\\\n#include\\\\n<cooperative_groups/reduce.h>\\\\n// Optionally include for inclusive_scan() and exclusive_scan() collectives\\\\n#include\\\\n<cooperative_groups/scan.h>\\\\nand use the Cooperative Groups namespace:\\\\nusing\\\\nnamespace\\\\ncooperative_groups\\\\n;\\\\n// Alternatively use an alias to avoid polluting the namespace with collective algorithms\\\\nnamespace\\\\ncg\\\\n=\\\\ncooperative_groups\\\\n;\\\\nThe code can be compiled in a normal way using nvcc, however if you wish to use memcpy_async, reduce or scan functionality and your host compiler’s default dialect is not C++11 or higher, then you must add\\\\n--std=c++11\\\\nto the command line.\\\\n8.3.1.\\\\nComposition Example\\\\n\\\\nTo illustrate the concept of groups, this example attempts to perform a block-wide sum reduction. Previously, there were hidden constraints on the implementation when writing this code:\\\\n__device__\\\\nint\\\\nsum\\\\n(\\\\nint\\\\n*\\\\nx\\\\n,\\\\nint\\\\nn\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\n// ...\\\\n__syncthreads\\\\n();\\\\nreturn\\\\ntotal\\\\n;\\\\n}\\\\n__global__\\\\nvoid\\\\nparallel_kernel\\\\n(\\\\nfloat\\\\n*\\\\nx\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\n// ...\\\\n// Entire thread block must call sum\\\\nsum\\\\n(\\\\nx\\\\n,\\\\nn\\\\n);\\\\n}\\\\nAll threads in the thread block must arrive at the\\\\n__syncthreads()\\\\nbarrier, however, this constraint is hidden from the developer who might want to use\\\\nsum(…)\\\\n. With Cooperative Groups, a better way of writing this would be:\\\\n__device__\\\\nint\\\\nsum\\\\n(\\\\nconst\\\\nthread_block\\\\n&\\\\ng\\\\n,\\\\nint\\\\n*\\\\nx\\\\n,\\\\nint\\\\nn\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\n// ...\\\\ng\\\\n.\\\\nsync\\\\n()\\\\nreturn\\\\ntotal\\\\n;\\\\n}\\\\n__global__\\\\nvoid\\\\nparallel_kernel\\\\n(...)\\\\n{\\\\n// ...\\\\n// Entire thread block must call sum\\\\nthread_block\\\\ntb\\\\n=\\\\nthis_thread_block\\\\n();\\\\nsum\\\\n(\\\\ntb\\\\n,\\\\nx\\\\n,\\\\nn\\\\n);\\\\n// ...\\\\n}\\\\n8.4.\\\\nGroup Types\\\\n\\\\n8.4.1.\\\\nImplicit Groups\\\\n\\\\nImplicit groups represent the launch configuration of the kernel. Regardless of how your kernel is written, it always has a set number of threads, blocks and block dimensions, a single grid and grid dimensions. In addition, if the multi-device cooperative launch API is used, it can have multiple grids (single grid per device). These groups provide a starting point for decomposition into finer grained groups which are typically HW accelerated and are more specialized for the problem the developer is solving.\\\\nAlthough you can create an implicit group anywhere in the code, it is dangerous to do so. Creating a handle for an implicit group is a collective operation—all threads in the group must participate. If the group was created in a conditional branch that not all threads reach, this can lead to deadlocks or data corruption. For this reason, it is recommended that you create a handle for the implicit group upfront (as early as possible, before any branching has occurred) and use that handle throughout the kernel. Group handles must be initialized at declaration time (there is no default constructor) for the same reason and copy-constructing them is discouraged.\\\\n8.4.1.1.\\\\nThread Block Group\\\\n\\\\nAny CUDA programmer is already familiar with a certain group of threads: the thread block. The Cooperative Groups extension introduces a new datatype,\\\\nthread_block\\\\n, to explicitly represent this concept within the kernel.\\\\nclass\\\\nthread_block;\\\\nConstructed via:\\\\nthread_block\\\\ng\\\\n=\\\\nthis_thread_block\\\\n();\\\\nPublic Member Functions:\\\\nstatic\\\\nvoid\\\\nsync()\\\\n: Synchronize the threads named in the group, equivalent to\\\\ng.barrier_wait(g.barrier_arrive())\\\\nthread_block::arrival_token\\\\nbarrier_arrive()\\\\n: Arrive on the thread_block barrier, returns a token that needs to be passed into\\\\nbarrier_wait()\\\\n. More details\\\\nhere\\\\nvoid\\\\nbarrier_wait(thread_block::arrival_token&&\\\\nt)\\\\n: Wait on the\\\\nthread_block\\\\nbarrier, takes arrival token returned from\\\\nbarrier_arrive()\\\\nas an rvalue reference. More details\\\\nhere\\\\nstatic\\\\nunsigned\\\\nint\\\\nthread_rank()\\\\n: Rank of the calling thread within [0, num_threads)\\\\nstatic\\\\ndim3\\\\ngroup_index()\\\\n: 3-Dimensional index of the block within the launched grid\\\\nstatic\\\\ndim3\\\\nthread_index()\\\\n: 3-Dimensional index of the thread within the launched block\\\\nstatic\\\\ndim3\\\\ndim_threads()\\\\n: Dimensions of the launched block in units of threads\\\\nstatic\\\\nunsigned\\\\nint\\\\nnum_threads()\\\\n: Total number of threads in the group\\\\nLegacy member functions (aliases):\\\\nstatic\\\\nunsigned\\\\nint\\\\nsize()\\\\n: Total number of threads in the group (alias of\\\\nnum_threads()\\\\n)\\\\nstatic\\\\ndim3\\\\ngroup_dim()\\\\n: Dimensions of the launched block (alias of\\\\ndim_threads()\\\\n)\\\\nExample:\\\\n/// Loading an integer from global into shared memory\\\\n__global__\\\\nvoid\\\\nkernel\\\\n(\\\\nint\\\\n*\\\\nglobalInput\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\n__shared__\\\\nint\\\\nx\\\\n;\\\\nthread_block\\\\ng\\\\n=\\\\nthis_thread_block\\\\n();\\\\n// Choose a leader in the thread block\\\\nif\\\\n(\\\\ng\\\\n.\\\\nthread_rank\\\\n()\\\\n==\\\\n0\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\n// load from global into shared for all threads to work with\\\\nx\\\\n=\\\\n(\\\\n*\\\\nglobalInput\\\\n);\\\\n}\\\\n// After loading data into shared memory, you want to synchronize\\\\n// if all threads in your thread block need to see it\\\\ng\\\\n.\\\\nsync\\\\n();\\\\n// equivalent to __syncthreads();\\\\n}\\\\nNote:\\\\nthat all threads in the group must participate in collective operations, or the behavior is undefined.\\\\nRelated:\\\\nThe\\\\nthread_block\\\\ndatatype is derived from the more generic\\\\nthread_group\\\\ndatatype, which can be used to represent a wider class of groups.\\\\n8.4.1.2.\\\\nCluster Group\\\\n\\\\nThis group object represents all the threads launched in a single cluster. If there exists a data-dependent conditional branch in the application code such that threads within a warp diverge, then the warp serially executes each branch disabling threads not on that path. The threads that remain active on the path are referred to as coalesced. Cooperative Groups has functionality to discover, and create, a group containing all coalesced threads.\\\\nConstructing the group handle via\\\\ncoalesced_threads()\\\\nis opportunistic. It returns the set of active threads at that point in time, and makes no guarantee about which threads are returned (as long as they are active) or that they will stay coalesced throughout execution (they will be brought back together for the execution of a collective but can diverge again afterwards).\\\\nclass\\\\ncoalesced_group;\\\\nConstructed via:\\\\ncoalesced_group\\\\nactive\\\\n=\\\\ncoalesced_threads\\\\n();\\\\nPublic Member Functions:\\\\nvoid\\\\nsync()\\\\nconst\\\\n: Synchronize the threads named in the group\\\\nunsigned\\\\nlong\\\\nlong\\\\nnum_threads()\\\\nconst\\\\n: Total number of threads in the group\\\\nunsigned\\\\nlong\\\\nlong\\\\nthread_rank()\\\\nconst\\\\n: Rank of the calling thread within [0, num_threads)\\\\nunsigned\\\\nlong\\\\nlong\\\\nmeta_group_size()\\\\nconst\\\\n: Returns the number of groups created when the parent group was partitioned. No assumption is made about the threads that are present, and instead developers work with the threads that happen to be there. This is seen in the following “aggregating atomic increment across threads in a warp” example (written using the correct CUDA 9.0 set of intrinsics):\\\\n{\\\\nunsigned\\\\nint\\\\nwritemask\\\\n=\\\\n__activemask\\\\n();\\\\nunsigned\\\\nint\\\\ntotal\\\\n=\\\\n__popc\\\\n(\\\\nwritemask\\\\n);\\\\nunsigned\\\\nint\\\\nprefix\\\\n=\\\\n__popc\\\\n(\\\\nwritemask\\\\n&\\\\n__lanemask_lt\\\\n());\\\\n// Find the lowest-numbered active lane\\\\nint\\\\nelected_lane\\\\n=\\\\n__ffs\\\\n(\\\\nwritemask\\\\n)\\\\n-\\\\n1\\\\n;\\\\nint\\\\nbase_offset\\\\n=\\\\n0\\\\n;\\\\nif\\\\n(\\\\nprefix\\\\n==\\\\n0\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\nbase_offset\\\\n=\\\\natomicAdd\\\\n(\\\\np\\\\n,\\\\ntotal\\\\n);\\\\n}\\\\nbase_offset\\\\n=\\\\n__shfl_sync\\\\n(\\\\nwritemask\\\\n,\\\\nbase_offset\\\\n,\\\\nelected_lane\\\\n);\\\\nint\\\\nthread_offset\\\\n=\\\\nprefix\\\\n+\\\\nbase_offset\\\\n;\\\\nreturn\\\\nthread_offset\\\\n;\\\\n}\\\\nThis can be re-written with Cooperative Groups as follows:\\\\n{\\\\ncg\\\\n::\\\\ncoalesced_group\\\\ng\\\\n=\\\\ncg\\\\n::\\\\ncoalesced_threads\\\\n();\\\\nint\\\\nprev\\\\n;\\\\nif\\\\n(\\\\ng\\\\n.\\\\nthread_rank\\\\n()\\\\n==\\\\n0\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\nprev\\\\n=\\\\natomicAdd\\\\n(\\\\np\\\\n,\\\\ng\\\\n.\\\\nnum_threads\\\\n());\\\\n}\\\\nprev\\\\n=\\\\ng\\\\n.\\\\nthread_rank\\\\n()\\\\n+\\\\ng\\\\n.\\\\nshfl\\\\n(\\\\nprev\\\\n,\\\\n0\\\\n);\\\\nreturn\\\\nprev\\\\n;\\\\n}\\\\n8.5.\\\\nGroup Partitioning\\\\n\\\\n8.5.1.\\\\ntiled_partition\\\\n\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\nunsigned\\\\nint\\\\nSize\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nParentT\\\\n>\\\\nthread_block_tile\\\\n<\\\\nSize\\\\n,\\\\nParentT\\\\n>\\\\ntiled_partition\\\\n(\\\\nconst\\\\nParentT\\\\n&\\\\ng\\\\n);\\\\nthread_group\\\\ntiled_partition\\\\n(\\\\nconst\\\\nthread_group\\\\n&\\\\nparent\\\\n,\\\\nunsigned\\\\nint\\\\ntilesz\\\\n);\\\\nThe\\\\ntiled_partition\\\\nmethod is a collective operation that partitions the parent group into a one-dimensional, row-major, tiling of subgroups. A total of ((size(parent)/tilesz) subgroups will be created, therefore the parent group size must be evenly divisible by the\\\\nSize\\\\n. The allowed parent groups are\\\\nthread_block\\\\nor\\\\nthread_block_tile\\\\n.\\\\nThe implementation may cause the calling thread to wait until all the members of the parent group have invoked the operation before resuming execution. Functionality is limited to native hardware sizes, 1/2/4/8/16/32 and the\\\\ncg::size(parent)\\\\nmust be greater than the\\\\nSize\\\\nparameter. The templated version of\\\\ntiled_partition\\\\nsupports 64/128/256/512 sizes as well, but some additional steps are required on Compute Capability 7.5 or lower, refer to\\\\nThread Block Tile\\\\nfor details.\\\\nCodegen Requirements:\\\\nCompute Capability 5.0 minimum, C++11 for sizes larger than 32\\\\nExample:\\\\n/// The following code will create a 32-thread tile\\\\nthread_block\\\\nblock\\\\n=\\\\nthis_thread_block\\\\n();\\\\nthread_block_tile\\\\n<\\\\n32\\\\n>\\\\ntile32\\\\n=\\\\ntiled_partition\\\\n<\\\\n32\\\\n>\\\\n(\\\\nblock\\\\n);\\\\nWe can partition each of these groups into even smaller groups, each of size 4 threads:\\\\nauto\\\\ntile4\\\\n=\\\\ntiled_partition\\\\n<\\\\n4\\\\n>\\\\n(\\\\ntile32\\\\n);\\\\n// or using a general group\\\\n// thread_group tile4 = tiled_partition(tile32, 4);\\\\nIf, for instance, if we were to then include the following line of code:\\\\nif\\\\n(\\\\ntile4\\\\n.\\\\nthread_rank\\\\n()\\\\n==\\\\n0\\\\n)\\\\nprintf\\\\n(\\\\n\\\\\\\"Hello from tile4 rank 0\\\\n\\\\\\\\n\\\\n\\\\\\\"\\\\n);\\\\nthen the statement would be printed by every fourth thread in the block: the threads of rank 0 in each\\\\ntile4\\\\ngroup, which correspond to those threads with ranks 0,4,8,12,etc. in the\\\\nblock\\\\ngroup.\\\\n8.5.2.\\\\nlabeled_partition\\\\n\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\ntypename\\\\nLabel\\\\n>\\\\ncoalesced_group\\\\nlabeled_partition\\\\n(\\\\nconst\\\\ncoalesced_group\\\\n&\\\\ng\\\\n,\\\\nLabel\\\\nlabel\\\\n);\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\nunsigned\\\\nint\\\\nSize\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nLabel\\\\n>\\\\ncoalesced_group\\\\nlabeled_partition\\\\n(\\\\nconst\\\\nthread_block_tile\\\\n<\\\\nSize\\\\n>&\\\\ng\\\\n,\\\\nLabel\\\\nlabel\\\\n);\\\\nThe\\\\nlabeled_partition\\\\nmethod is a collective operation that partitions the parent group into one-dimensional subgroups within which the threads are coalesced. Otherwise the behavior of the call is undefined.\\\\n8.6.1.\\\\nSynchronization\\\\n\\\\n8.6.1.1.\\\\nbarrier_arrive\\\\nand\\\\nbarrier_wait\\\\n\\\\nT\\\\n::\\\\narrival_token\\\\nT::barrier_arrive\\\\n();\\\\nvoid\\\\nT::barrier_wait\\\\n(\\\\nT\\\\n::\\\\narrival_token\\\\n&&\\\\n);\\\\nbarrier_arrive\\\\nand\\\\nbarrier_wait\\\\nmember functions provide a synchronization API similar to\\\\ncuda::barrier\\\\n(read more)\\\\n. Cooperative Groups automatically initializes the group barrier, but arrive and wait operations have an additional restriction resulting from collective nature of those operations: All threads in the group must arrive and wait at the barrier once per phase.\\\\n\\\\nWhen\\\\nbarrier_arrive\\\\nis called with a group, result of calling any collective operation or another barrier arrival with that group is undefined until completion of the barrier phase is observed with\\\\nbarrier_wait\\\\ncall. Threads blocked on\\\\nbarrier_wait\\\\nmight be released from the synchronization before other threads call\\\\nbarrier_wait\\\\n, but only after all threads in the group called\\\\nbarrier_arrive\\\\n.\\\\n\\\\nGroup type\\\\nT\\\\ncan be any of the\\\\nimplicit groups\\\\n.This allows threads to do independent work after they arrive and before they wait for the synchronization to resolve, allowing to hide some of the synchronization latency.\\\\nbarrier_arrive\\\\nreturns an\\\\narrival_token\\\\nobject that must be passed into the corresponding\\\\nbarrier_wait\\\\n. Token is consumed this way and can not be used for another\\\\nbarrier_wait\\\\ncall.\\\\nExample of barrier_arrive and barrier_wait used to synchronize initization of shared memory across the cluster:\\\\n#include\\\\n<cooperative_groups.h>\\\\nusing\\\\nnamespace\\\\ncooperative_groups\\\\n;\\\\nvoid\\\\n__device__\\\\ninit_shared_data\\\\n(\\\\nconst\\\\nthread_block\\\\n&\\\\nblock\\\\n,\\\\nint\\\\n*\\\\ndata\\\\n);\\\\nvoid\\\\n__device__\\\\nlocal_processing\\\\n(\\\\nconst\\\\nthread_block\\\\n&\\\\nblock\\\\n);\\\\nvoid\\\\n__device__\\\\nprocess_shared_data\\\\n(\\\\nconst\\\\nthread_block\\\\n&\\\\nblock\\\\n,\\\\nint\\\\n*\\\\ndata\\\\n);\\\\n__global__\\\\nvoid\\\\ncluster_kernel\\\\n()\\\\n{\\\\nextern\\\\n__shared__\\\\nint\\\\narray\\\\n[];\\\\nauto\\\\ncluster\\\\n=\\\\nthis_cluster\\\\n();\\\\nauto\\\\nblock\\\\n=\\\\nthis_thread_block\\\\n();\\\\n// Use this thread block to initialize some shared state\\\\ninit_shared_data\\\\n(\\\\nblock\\\\n,\\\\n&\\\\narray\\\\n[\\\\n0\\\\n]);\\\\nauto\\\\ntoken\\\\n=\\\\ncluster\\\\n.\\\\nbarrier_arrive\\\\n();\\\\n// Let other blocks know this block is running and data was initialized\\\\n// Do some local processing to hide the synchronization latency\\\\nlocal_processing\\\\n(\\\\nblock\\\\n);\\\\n// Map data in shared memory from the next block in the cluster\\\\nint\\\\n*\\\\ndsmem\\\\n=\\\\ncluster\\\\n.\\\\nmap_shared_rank\\\\n(\\\\n&\\\\narray\\\\n[\\\\n0\\\\n],\\\\n(\\\\ncluster\\\\n.\\\\nblock_rank\\\\n()\\\\n+\\\\n1\\\\n)\\\\n%\\\\ncluster\\\\n.\\\\nnum_blocks\\\\n());\\\\n// memory\\\\nprocess_shared_data\\\\n(\\\\nblock\\\\n,\\\\ndsmem\\\\n);\\\\ncluster\\\\n.\\\\nsync\\\\n();\\\\n}\\\\n8.6.1.2.\\\\nsync\\\\n\\\\nstatic\\\\nvoid\\\\nT::sync\\\\n();\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\ntypename\\\\nT\\\\n>\\\\nvoid\\\\nsync\\\\n(\\\\nT\\\\n&\\\\ngroup\\\\n);\\\\nsync\\\\nsynchronizes the threads named in the group. Group type\\\\nT\\\\ncan be any of the existing group types, as all of them support synchronization. Its available as a member function in every group type or as a free function taking a group as parameter.\\\\n\\\\nIf the group is a\\\\ngrid_group\\\\nor a\\\\nmulti_grid_group\\\\nthe kernel must have been launched using the appropriate cooperative launch APIs. Equivalent to\\\\nT.barrier_wait(T.barrier_arrive())\\\\n.\\\\n8.6.2.\\\\nData Transfer\\\\n\\\\n8.6.2.1.\\\\nmemcpy_async\\\\n\\\\nmemcpy_async\\\\nis a group-wide collective memcpy that utilizes hardware accelerated support for non-blocking memory transactions from global to shared memory. Given a set of threads named in the group,\\\\nmemcpy_async\\\\nwill move specified amount of bytes or elements of the input type through a single pipeline stage. Additionally for achieving best performance when using the\\\\nmemcpy_async\\\\nAPI, an alignment of 16 bytes for both shared memory and global memory is required. It is important to note that while this is a memcpy in the general case, it is only asynchronous if the source is global memory and the destination is shared memory and both can be addressed with 16, 8, or 4 byte alignments. Asynchronously copied data should only be read following a call to wait or wait_prior which signals that the corresponding stage has completed moving data to shared memory.\\\\nHaving to wait on all outstanding requests can lose some flexibility (but gain simplicity). In order to efficiently overlap data transfer and execution, its important to be able to kick off an\\\\nN+1\\\\nmemcpy_async\\\\nrequest while waiting on and operating on request\\\\nN\\\\n. To do so, use\\\\nmemcpy_async\\\\nand wait on it using the collective stage-based\\\\nwait_prior\\\\nAPI. See\\\\nwait and wait_prior\\\\nfor more details.\\\\nUsage 1\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyGroup\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyElem\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyShape\\\\n>\\\\nvoid\\\\nmemcpy_async\\\\n(\\\\nconst\\\\nTyGroup\\\\n&\\\\ngroup\\\\n,\\\\nTyElem\\\\n*\\\\n__restrict__\\\\n_dst\\\\n,\\\\nconst\\\\nTyElem\\\\n*\\\\n__restrict__\\\\n_src\\\\n,\\\\nconst\\\\nTyShape\\\\n&\\\\nshape\\\\n);\\\\nPerforms a copy of\\\\n``shape`` bytes\\\\n.\\\\nUsage 2\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyGroup\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyElem\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyDstLayout\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nTySrcLayout\\\\n>\\\\nvoid\\\\nmemcpy_async\\\\n(\\\\nconst\\\\nTyGroup\\\\n&\\\\ngroup\\\\n,\\\\nTyElem\\\\n*\\\\n__restrict__\\\\ndst\\\\n,\\\\nconst\\\\nTyDstLayout\\\\n&\\\\ndstLayout\\\\n,\\\\nconst\\\\nTyElem\\\\n*\\\\n__restrict__\\\\nsrc\\\\n,\\\\nconst\\\\nTySrcLayout\\\\n&\\\\nsrcLayout\\\\n);\\\\nPerforms a copy of\\\\n``min(dstLayout, srcLayout)`` elements\\\\n. If layouts are of type\\\\ncuda::aligned_size_t<N>\\\\n, both must specify the same alignment.\\\\nErrata\\\\nThe\\\\nmemcpy_async\\\\nAPI introduced in CUDA 11.1 with both src and dst input layouts, expects the layout to be provided in elements rather than bytes. The element type is inferred from\\\\nTyElem\\\\nand has the size\\\\nsizeof(TyElem)\\\\n. If\\\\ncuda::aligned_size_t<N>\\\\ntype is used as the layout, the number of elements specified times\\\\nsizeof(TyElem)\\\\nmust be a multiple of N and it is recommended to use\\\\nstd::byte\\\\nor\\\\nchar\\\\nas the element type.\\\\nIf specified shape or layout of the copy is of type\\\\ncuda::aligned_size_t<N>\\\\n, alignment will be guaranteed to be at least\\\\nmin(16,\\\\nN)\\\\n. In that case both\\\\ndst\\\\nand\\\\nsrc\\\\npointers need to be aligned to N bytes and the number of bytes copied needs to be a multiple of N.\\\\nCodegen Requirements:\\\\nCompute Capability 5.0 minimum, Compute Capability 8.0 for asynchronicity, C++11\\\\ncooperative_groups/memcpy_async.h\\\\nheader needs to be included.\\\\nExample:\\\\n/// This example streams elementsPerThreadBlock worth Manipulation\\\\n\\\\n8.6.3.1.\\\\nreduce\\\\n\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyGroup\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyArg\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyOp\\\\n>\\\\nauto\\\\nreduce\\\\n(\\\\nconst\\\\nTyGroup\\\\n&\\\\ngroup\\\\n,\\\\nTyArg\\\\n&&\\\\nval\\\\n,\\\\nTyOp\\\\n&&\\\\nop\\\\n)\\\\n->\\\\ndecltype\\\\n(\\\\nop\\\\n(\\\\nval\\\\n,\\\\nval\\\\n));\\\\nreduce\\\\nperforms a reduction operation on the data provided by each thread named in the group passed in. This takes advantage of hardware acceleration (on compute 80 and higher devices) for the arithmetic add, min, or max operations and the logical AND, OR, or XOR, as well as providing a software fallback on older generation hardware. Only 4B types are accelerated by hardware.\\\\ngroup\\\\n: Valid group types are\\\\ncoalesced_group\\\\nand\\\\nthread_block_tile\\\\n.\\\\nval\\\\n: Any type that satisfies the below requirements:\\\\nQualifies as trivially copyable i.e.\\\\nis_trivially_copyable<TyArg>::value\\\\n==\\\\ntrue\\\\nsizeof(T)\\\\n<=\\\\n32\\\\nfor\\\\ncoalesced_group\\\\nand tiles of size lower or equal 32,\\\\nsizeof(T)\\\\n<=\\\\n8\\\\nfor larger tiles\\\\nHas suitable arithmetic or comparative operators for the given function object.\\\\nNote:\\\\nDifferent threads in the group can pass different values for this argument.\\\\nop\\\\n: Valid function objects that will provide hardware acceleration with integral types are\\\\nplus(),\\\\nless(),\\\\ngreater(),\\\\nbit_and(),\\\\nbit_xor(),\\\\nbit_or()\\\\n. These must be constructed, hence the TyVal template argument is required, i.e.\\\\nplus<int>()\\\\n. Reduce also supports lambdas and other function objects that can be invoked using\\\\noperator()\\\\nAsynchronous reduce\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyGroup\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyArg\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyAtomic\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyOp\\\\n>\\\\nvoid\\\\nreduce_update_async\\\\n(\\\\nconst\\\\nTyGroup\\\\n&\\\\ngroup\\\\n,\\\\nTyAtomic\\\\n&\\\\natomic\\\\n,\\\\nTyArg\\\\n&&\\\\nval\\\\n,\\\\nTyOp\\\\n&&\\\\nop\\\\n);\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyGroup\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyArg\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyAtomic\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyOp\\\\n>\\\\nvoid\\\\nreduce_store_async\\\\n(\\\\nconst\\\\nTyGroup\\\\n&\\\\ngroup\\\\n,\\\\nTyAtomic\\\\n&\\\\natomic\\\\n,\\\\nTyArg\\\\n&&\\\\nval\\\\n,\\\\nTyOp\\\\n&&\\\\nop\\\\n);\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyGroup\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyArg\\\\n,\\\\ntypename\\\\nTyOp\\\\n>\\\\nvoid\\\\nreduce_store_async\\\\n(\\\\nconst\\\\nTyGroup\\\\n&\\\\ngroup\\\\n,\\\\nTyArg\\\\n*\\\\nptr\\\\n,\\\\nTyArg\\\\n&&\\\\nval\\\\n,\\\\nTyOp\\\\n&&\\\\nop\\\\n);\\\\n*_async\\\\nvariants of the API are asynchronously calculating the result to either store to or update a specified destination by one of the participating threads, instead of returning it by each thread. To observe the effect of these asynchronous calls, calling group of threads or a larger group containing them need to be synchronized.\\\\nIn case of the atomic store or update variant,\\\\natomic\\\\nargument can be either of\\\\ncuda::atomic\\\\nor\\\\ncuda::atomic_ref\\\\navailable in\\\\nCUDA C++ Standard Library\\\\n. This variant of the API is available only on platforms and devices, where these types are supported by the CUDA C++ Standard Library. Result of the reduction is used to atomically update the atomic according to the specified\\\\nop\\\\n, eg. the result is atomically added to the atomic in case of\\\\ncg::plus()\\\\n. Type held by the\\\\natomic\\\\nmust match the type of\\\\nTyArg\\\\n. Scope of the atomic must include all the threads in the group and if multiple groups are using the same atomic concurrently, scope must include all threads in all groups using it. Atomic update is performed with relaxed memory ordering.\\\\nIn case of the pointer store variant, result of the reduction will be weakly stored into the\\\\ndst\\\\npointer.\\\\nCodegen can be done with\\\\nreduce\\\\nnamespace\\\\ncooperative_groups\\\\n{\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\ntypename\\\\nTy\\\\n>\\\\nstruct\\\\ncg\\\\n::\\\\nplus\\\\n;\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\ntypename\\\\nTy\\\\n>\\\\nstruct\\\\ncg\\\\n::\\\\nless\\\\n;\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\ntypename\\\\nTy\\\\n>\\\\nstruct\\\\ncg\\\\n::\\\\ngreater\\\\n;\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\ntypename\\\\nTy\\\\n>\\\\nstruct\\\\ncg\\\\n::\\\\nbit_and\\\\n;\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\ntypename\\\\nTy\\\\n>\\\\nstruct\\\\ncg\\\\n::\\\\nbit_xor\\\\n;\\\\ntemplate\\\\n<\\\\ntypename\\\\nTy\\\\n>\\\\nstruct\\\\ncg\\\\n::\\\\nbit_or\\\\n;\\\\n}\\\\nReduce is limited to the information available to the implementation at compile time. Thus in order to make use of intrinsics introduced in CC 8.0, the\\\\ncg::\\\\nnamespace exposes several functional objects that mirror the hardware. These objects appear similar to those presented in the C++ STL, with the exception of\\\\nless/greater\\\\n. The reason for any difference from the STL is that these function objects are designed to actually mirror the operation of the hardware intrinsics.\\\\nFunctional description:\\\\ncg::plus:\\\\nAccepts two values and returns the sum of both using operator+.\\\\ncg::less:\\\\nAccepts two values and returns the lesser using operator<. This differs in that the\\\\nlower value is returned\\\\nrather than a Boolean.\\\\ncg::greater:\\\\nAccepts two values and returns the greater using operator<. This differs in that the\\\\ngreater value is returned\\\\nrather than a Boolean.\\\\ncg::bit_and:\\\\nAccepts two values and returns the result of operator&.\\\\ncg::bit_xor:\\\\nAccepts two values and returns the result of operator^.\\\\ncg::bit_or:\\\\nAccepts two values and returns the result of operator|.\\\\nExample:\\\\n{\\\\n// cg::plus<int> is specialized within cg::reduce and calls Synchronization\\\\n\\\\nPrior to the introduction of Cooperative Groups, the CUDA programming model only allowed synchronization between thread blocks at a kernel completion boundary. The kernel boundary carries with it an implicit invalidation of state, and with it, potential performance implications.\\\\nFor example, in certain use cases, applications have a large number of small kernels, with each kernel representing a stage in a processing pipeline. The presence of these kernels is required by the current CUDA programming model to ensure that the thread blocks operating on one pipeline stage have produced data before the thread block operating on the next pipeline stage is ready to consume it. In such cases, the ability to provide global inter thread block synchronization would allow the application to be restructured to have persistent thread blocks, which are able to synchronize on the device when a given stage is complete.\\\\nTo synchronize across the grid, from within a kernel, you would simply use the\\\\ngrid.sync()\\\\nfunction:\\\\ngrid_group\\\\ngrid\\\\n=\\\\nthis_grid\\\\n();\\\\ngrid\\\\n.\\\\nsync\\\\n();\\\\nAnd when launching the kernel it is necessary to use, instead of the\\\\n<<<...>>>\\\\nexecution configuration syntax, the\\\\ncudaLaunchCooperativeKernel\\\\nCUDA runtime launch API or the\\\\nCUDA\\\\ndriver\\\\nequivalent\\\\n.\\\\nExample:\\\\nTo guarantee co-residency of the thread blocks on the GPU, the number of blocks launched needs to be carefully considered. follows:\\\\nint\\\\ndev\\\\n=\\\\n0\\\\n;\\\\ncudaDeviceProp\\\\ndeviceProp\\\\n;\\\\ncudaGetDeviceProperties\\\\n(\\\\n&\\\\ndeviceProp\\\\n,\\\\ndev\\\\n);\\\\n// initialize, then code can be found in the\\\\nvectorAddDrv\\\\nCUDA sample.\\\\n17.1.\\\\nContext\\\\n\\\\nA CUDA context is analogous to a CPU process. All resources and actions performed within the driver API are encapsulated inside a CUDA context, and the system automatically cleans up these resources when the context is destroyed. Besides objects such as modules and texture or surface references, each context has its own distinct address space. As a result,\\\\nCUdeviceptr\\\\nvalues from different contexts reference different memory locations.\\\\nA host thread may have only one device context current at a time. When a context is created with\\\\ncuCtxCreate(\\\\n), it is made current to the calling host thread. CUDA functions that operate in a context (most functions that do not involve device enumeration or context management) will return\\\\nCUDA_ERROR_INVALID_CONTEXT\\\\nif a valid context is not current to the thread.\\\\nEach host thread has a stack of current contexts.\\\\ncuCtxCreate()\\\\npushes the new context onto the top of the stack.\\\\ncuCtxPopCurrent()\\\\nmay be called to detach the context from the host thread. The context is then “floating” and may be pushed as the current context for any host thread.\\\\ncuCtxPopCurrent()\\\\nalso restores the previous current context, if any.\\\\nA usage count is also maintained for each context.\\\\ncuCtxCreate()\\\\ncreates a context with a usage count of 1.\\\\ncuCtxAttach()\\\\nincrements the usage count and\\\\ncuCtxDetach()\\\\ndecrements it. A context is destroyed when the usage count goes to 0 when calling\\\\ncuCtxDetach()\\\\nor\\\\ncuCtxDestroy()\\\\n.\\\\nThe driver API is interoperable with the runtime and it is possible to access the\\\\nprimary context\\\\n(see\\\\nInitialization\\\\n) managed by the runtime from the driver API via\\\\ncuDevicePrimaryCtxRetain()\\\\n.\\\\nUsage count facilitates interoperability between third party authored code operating in the same context. For example, if three libraries are loaded to use the same context, each library would call\\\\ncuCtxAttach()\\\\nto increment the usage count and\\\\ncuCtxDetach()\\\\nto decrement the usage count when the library is done using the context. For most libraries, it is expected that the application will have created a context before loading or initializing the library; that way, the application can create the context using its own heuristics, and the library simply operates on the context handed to it. Libraries that wish to create their own contexts - unbeknownst to their API clients who may or may not have created contexts of their own - would use\\\\ncuCtxPushCurrent()\\\\nand\\\\ncuCtxPopCurrent()\\\\nas illustrated in the following figure.\\\\nFigure 40\\\\nLibrary Context Management\\\\n\\\\n17.2.\\\\nModule\\\\n\\\\nModules are Attention 模块](attention-module.md)。它不增加 Agent 的角色义务，也不要求每章采用同一结构、同样多的算例或统一的工程路线。\\\\n\\\\n## 知识库承担什么任务\\\\n\\\\n本库支持 InfraAgents 根据模型、workload、硬件和服务目标，从空工程构建、检验与持续优化完整推理系统。知识应提供五种帮助：还原问题的理论基础；区分合法条件与可探索的设计空间；给出足以独立实现的算法与状态关系；支持成本预测、实验和诊断；保存能够被反驳、修正和迁移的经验。\\\\n\\\\n一条有用的阅读链应支持读者形成这样的推理：任务与输入条件 → 正确性要求 → 候选算法与数据流 → 成本预测 → 区分实验 → 实现结果 → 修正后的结论。某一章可以承担其中一部分，但承担核心算法的地方不能只列注意事项或把关键步骤交给源码。\\\\n\\\\n## 六项标准怎样落实到实际问题\\\\n\\\\n| 内容标准 | 审阅时实际追问 | 过去发现的问题及其含义 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| 原因、数学定义、输入输出和状态 | 为什么需要这个机制？每个量的轴、单位、范围和身份是什么？状态代表已知、已算、已确认还是已分配？ | FP8 只写“使用块尺度”不足以恢复分数和 PV 的共同单位；调度中的 token 已生成不等于其 KV 已计算 |\\\\n| 合法性与方案选择 | 哪条性质来自函数、数值契约或设备语义，哪条来自某个方案？等价性在实数、浮点还是特定误差范围内成立？ | 精确算术的归约结合性不能直接变成浮点逐位相同；图地址稳定不证明数据身份仍正确；内部 fragment 未公开就不能猜 lane 映射 |\\\\n| 算法、数据流和状态变化 | 能否写出初始化、推进、提交和结束？第一块、最后一块、空输入和失败分支怎样处理？每个被消费的量从哪里产生？ | 量化流程需要量化与恢复尺度；缓冲需要生产者、所有消费者及代次；硬件专题需要一条从逻辑 tile 到地址、线程、片上布局、指令输入和写回的完整路径 |\\\\n| 六类成本 | 是否在同一候选、相同输入和相同时间范围中列账？哪些量可以相加，哪些受关键路径和共享资源限制？ | 唯一 KV、各 head 请求流量和 DRAM 事务不能混算；共享容量只计一次；预留池与其中存活对象不能重复相加；深流水的驻留和 spill 会改变本来用于估时的吞吐 |\\\\n| 条件变化后的选择 | 改变 shape、状态组织、精度、到达轨迹或设备能力，哪条依赖保留，哪项成本改变？何种结果足以推翻原选择？ | 更多分区在并行度不足时有利，在已经饱和时可能只增加合并；更多缓冲不保证更快；缓存命中不保证新请求可立即执行 |\\\\n| 区分竞争解释 | 观察支持哪些解释？它们对某个可控改变给出什么不同预测？实验结果不符后怎样修改判断？ | “三级比两级慢”同时允许首尾、spill、驻留和未重叠解释；一次时间测量不能决定原因；软件事件模型不能证明 GPU 的内存可见性 |\\\\n\\\\n这些问题由主题决定使用范围。调度章节需要把就绪性、预算和输出归属连起来；缓存章节需要贯通身份、复制、发布和回收；硬件章节需要贯通布局、执行契约和资源。协议、统计或模型语义章节不必凭空增加矩阵指令实例。\\\\n\\\\n## 从单个机制走到组合案例\\\\n\\\\n分开解释各个机制之后，选择会改变合法性或成本的真实交界，追踪一次完整变化。例如共享前缀和私有尾块在追加、封存、发布、消费与回收期间，内容、scale、页表和读者必须属于一致的状态；调度器选中的工作必须已有上游输入和容量，而执行视图的压紧不能改变请求归属。\\\\n\\\\n审阅者沿一次轨迹检查：发生了什么输入事件；哪些对象仍存活；谁能写；谁已经取得读取权；何时对消费者可见；失败后哪些旧状态仍有效；取消后哪些工作仍在途；何时能把同一物理资源交给下一使用者。对象需要身份或代次时，解释防止的具体错误。只有单次同步执行的算法不必引入多代次协议。\\\\n\\\\n交界还包括“看似已经完成，下一步却没有输入”的状态。本轮调度审阅发现：完整命中 KV 而没有末行 logits 时，只按已知长度减 KV 长度选择工作会得到零，无法生成第一个新 token。修订明确了安全重算最后一个已知 token 的路径及共享写区隔离。沿状态图检查是否存在有合法请求却无后继事件的停滞，比只检查各状态的字段范围更有用。\\\\n\\\\n组合案例应使读者能计算至少一项会影响决定的代价，并解释另一种选择何时反转。重点是让独立机制能够正确拼接，不是枚举所有组合。示例的页长、tile、队列策略和版本字段均为可替换选择。\\\\n\\\\n## 阅读链与事实核对\\\\n\\\\n先检查正文承担的核心知识，再检查直接来源说明与足以支持关键事实的固定论文或文档。保留原始资料的错误、版本身份和字节，在解释中纠正公式或限定结论；自己的推导不能归为论文实测。源码可以用于作者核对，但读者独立实现所需的事实应进入允许读取的算法说明。\\\\n\\\\n审查记录写明读过哪些正文、哪些来源及其范围、发现的具体问题、实际修改与检查。只有读取摘要、术语检索或运行链接检查的专题，继续保留深度复核待完成状态。没有必要为了一个确定问题递归阅读所有引用。\\\\n\\\\n## 内容与使用效果分别验收\\\\n\\\\n内容审查判断六项标准在声明范围内是否有充分解释。作者侧算例验证代数、布局、边界、协议或成本模型；它需要独立参考、不变量或能触发错误的负对照，不能只让测试复述实现。读取测试检查冻结内容能否被取回及身份是否匹配。这三类证据各自有效，不能互相代替。\\\\n\\\\n直接使用检验让 Agent 在没有现成实现的情况下处理正文未直接演示的问题：重新推导合法算法，改变输入或硬件条件后重算，面对错误提出竞争解释，收到反证后修改方案。保存允许资料、任务、模型/上下文、预算、答卷或实现、执行结果及失败归因。交叉审阅兼做推导练习可以发现内容缺口，但有共同上下文、作者经验或未隔离的环境时，只能声称完成这次练习。\\\\n\\\\n如果要声称“知识改善了 Agent 的构建能力”，还需可比的知识版本或对照条件、多个代表任务以及预先说明的判断方法。目标 GPU 的数值、同步、重叠和性能仍需设备结果。没有最佳 tile 或流水级数不构成知识缺陷；没有解释如何推导候选、识别限制、测量与修正，才是内容缺口。\\\\n\\\\n## 怎样给出审查结论\\\\n\\\\n对每个问题给出正文位置、明确结论与证据边界，区分“已完整解释”“仅提及”“缺推导”“缺证据”“缺失”。这些描述可按实际内容组合使用，不转成总分或用测试数量抵消关键算法缺口。\\\\n\\\\n已经修复的问题在新修订中复核后关闭，不沿用旧审查中“仍缺 FP8/硬件映射/组合案例”的判断。新的缺口必须来自当前字节。Attention 当前的两个具体案例已补足内容展开，实际 Agent 独立构建与目标 GPU 效果仍有各自的验证边界。以当前内容和当前证据决定结论，不为了持续审查而不断增加验收条件。\\\\n\\\\n扩展工作优先完成相关专题的一条知识链，再复核跨专题衔接。当前批次与逐篇状态见[扩展状态](expansion-status.json)；历史审查保留当时结论，不覆盖成当前状态。\\\\n\\\", \\\"extraction\\\": \\\"UTF-8 text\\\", \\\"selection_reason\\\": \\\"full extracted text fits allocation\\\"}, {\\\"path\\\": \\\"knowledge/system-semantics/collective-ordering.md\\\", \\\"sha256\\\": \\\"0007f921f7cac18dfc14baae23133812bd3c58a6f8fc0bddde1d6d0a3d017168\\\", \\\"reading_scope\\\": \\\"full\\\", \\\"category\\\": \\\"required\\\", \\\"content\\\": \\\"# K-SYS-005：集合通信：参与集合、操作顺序与失败传播\\\\n\\\\n分布式前向是一组共同执行协议；每个 rank 的局部控制流必须形成匹配的通信序列。接入并行边界、研究新的布局或验证通信原型时，都可以使用这些关系；具体要表达的字段和检查取决于所选数学分解、执行库与任务，不要求先形成固定数量的候选或统一计划文件。\\\\n\\\\n## 集体操作的语义对象\\\\n\\\\ncommunicator 定义参与 ranks，操作定义数据类型、数量、归约方式和必要的 root。all-reduce 需要所有参与者对同一逻辑步骤达成对应关系。一个 rank 提前进入下一层的 all-reduce，而另一个仍在上一层，可能让不同数据被匹配或形成等待。\\\\n\\\\ngroup 调用帮助成组提交多个通信操作，不自动修正应用层顺序错误。异步返回也不表示输出已经可以由后续 stream 读取，通信本身要进入生产消费依赖图。\\\\n\\\\n## 动态请求如何保持共同视图\\\\n\\\\nTP ranks 通常共同处理同一逻辑 batch，EOS、取消、投机接受长度和新请求加入都需要一致更新。若 rank 0 因某请求取消跳过一层，而其他 ranks 仍执行其 collective，局部“省工作”破坏整体协议。可以统一调度决定或用明确的控制广播维护共同视图。\\\\n\\\\nEP 的每对发送/接收数量可随路由变化，但双方对元数据和数据交换次序必须一致。零 token 专家/rank 仍需遵守协议要求，不能因为本地没有工作就跳过其他参与者等待的步骤。\\\\n\\\\n## 失败是什么状态转换\\\\n\\\\n一个 rank OOM、进程退出或通信失败时，其余 ranks 可能停在等待。任务级状态需要传播失败并终止相应执行组，保留最早错误和其他 rank 的上下文。超时只说明在时间预算内未完成，不自动区分网络慢、顺序错和对端已死。\\\\n\\\\n恢复时，如果无法证明所有 ranks 的持久状态一致，可以从共同的已提交前缀重新建立执行，而不能让部分 ranks 沿旧状态继续。这里的提交点与 KV 迁移和请求代次相同，都是让局部结果变成全系统可依赖状态的边界。\\\\n\\\\n## 调度代次与通信代次共同推进\\\\n\\\\n动态 batch、专家路由和迁移改变本轮数据量，但 communicator、参与集合、操作序号和数据解释仍需一致。控制面应先形成共同执行决定，再让各 rank 提交匹配工作；本地取消或空分片不能独立改变其他参与者期待的操作序列。\\\\n\\\\n并发通信与计算是否安全取决于固定库版本、communicator/stream 关系和全局调用顺序。某个历史系统选择另一条传输路径，不证明所有版本的 NCCL 都具有相同限制；反过来，有多个 stream 也不保证任意交错都合法。\\\\n\\\\n## 错误传播与恢复证据\\\\n\\\\n保留每个 rank 最早失败、已提交操作、完成状态及被阻塞的依赖。设备失效或无法证明共同状态一致时，应终止受影响执行组并从共同恢复点重建；不能让幸存 rank 独自跳过失败步骤。新的执行代次不能继续使用旧组未确认的局部结果。\\\\n\\\\n故障注入覆盖一个 rank 在 metadata 交换前后、数据传输前后或提交前退出，以及零工作 rank 仍需参与的边界。检查所有参与者最终进入一致终态，资源完成关系不悬挂，并把诊断中的超时与根因分开记录。\\\\n\\\\n## 张量解释、count 与每 rank 容量\\\\n\\\\nNCCL Collective Operations 的固定定义要求各 rank 使用匹配 count 与 datatype；即便这些值相同，应用仍可能把不同请求顺序或 hidden 通道的元素错误地相加。调用还要保持全局轴、rank 布局、逻辑推进与生产消费关系一致。非连续输入是否需要 packing、允许何种原位使用，应按所选函数与固定版本核对；形状一致不自动建立这些保证。\\\\n\\\\n以下以参与者数 \\\\\\\\(p\\\\\\\\)、每元素 \\\\\\\\(b\\\\\\\\) 字节及语义块长 \\\\\\\\(N\\\\\\\\) 为符号，列出输入与输出分开分配时的主缓冲关系，不含库内部暂存。\\\\n\\\\n| 操作 | 每 rank 的输入与输出 | 容量与解释 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| AllReduce | 输入 \\\\\\\\(N\\\\\\\\) 个值，各 rank 得到同一 \\\\\\\\(N\\\\\\\\) 元素归约结果 | 输入/输出各 \\\\\\\\(Nb\\\\\\\\) 字节；同一位置应有相同全局含义 |\\\\n| AllGather | 每 rank 输入 \\\\\\\\(N\\\\\\\\) 个值，各接收 \\\\\\\\(pN\\\\\\\\) 个值 | 输入 \\\\\\\\(Nb\\\\\\\\)、输出 \\\\\\\\(pNb\\\\\\\\) 字节；输出块按 communicator rank 排列 |\\\\n| ReduceScatter | 每 rank 输入 \\\\\\\\(pN\\\\\\\\) 个值，归约后各得到 \\\\\\\\(N\\\\\\\\) 元素块 | 输入 \\\\\\\\(pNb\\\\\\\\)、输出 \\\\\\\\(Nb\\\\\\\\) 字节；rank 决定取得哪一块 |\\\\n| Reduce | 各 rank 提供相同逻辑位置的 \\\\\\\\(N\\\\\\\\) 个值，仅 root 得到结果 | 仅 root 需要该操作的归约输出；root 是 communicator rank |\\\\n| Broadcast | root 的 \\\\\\\\(N\\\\\\\\) 元素内容分发给参与者 | root、内容版本及接收后的解释必须一致 |\\\\n\\\\n这里的 \\\\\\\\(N\\\\\\\\) 是数学块长，不能不经核对就当成每个 API 的 count 参数。AllGather 的总接收数与每 rank 发送数不同，ReduceScatter 的总输入数与每 rank 输出数不同；字节数还需乘 dtype 大小。改变 rank 到设备的映射后，解释层仍需知道每块对应的全局张量；物理 GPU 编号不是 root 的同义项。\\\\n\\\\n执行机制需要维持请求/微批、层、阶段、模型版本与通信代次的对应。诊断或交接时，可按需要记录这些关系及相关 communicator、元素解释、生产者和消费者。详细检查可以置于 test/profile 路径，不要求每次生产通信前增加全局校验，但正常执行所依赖的身份和顺序关系不能因此关闭。TP、PP、EP 的张量分解与逐层账本见 [推理并行](../algorithms/parallelism.md)。\\\\n\\\\n## Group 的提交完成不同于通信完成\\\\n\\\\n固定 NCCL 2.25.1 的 Group Calls 规定，组内通信调用返回时可能尚未把操作加入 CUDA stream，因此不能在 group 尚未合法结束时用 stream 完成检查代替组提交。聚合还会延后部分操作的启动；即使减少了 launch 数，若关键消费者等待更久，端到端可能变慢。\\\\n\\\\nnonblocking communicator 增加另一层边界。`ncclGroupEnd` 返回 `ncclInProgress` 时，kernel 仍可能在后台入队；应按 `ncclCommGetAsyncError` 等该版本规定的状态检查确认相关 communicator 进入成功，再进行依赖这批提交的 CUDA 操作。这里的成功仅表示提交成功，之后仍需等待相应设备工作完成，后续 stream 才能在正确依赖下消费结果。\\\\n\\\\n因此，一次调用的事实应区分“组已形成”“相关操作已提交”“设备通信已完成”“应用结果可提交”。失败可能发生在这些边界之间，局部函数成功不能抹掉稍后报告的错误。将不同 communicator 或 stream 混用时，也应核对当前固定版本的具体并发规则；本文的提交模型并不授权任意跨组交错。\\\\n\\\\n## 用可辨识反例检查所选通信边界\\\\n\\\\n一个可以手工复算的输入是四个 rank 各提供 8 个整数，rank \\\\\\\\(r\\\\\\\\) 的第 \\\\\\\\(i\\\\\\\\) 项为 \\\\\\\\(100r+i\\\\\\\\)，其中 \\\\\\\\(r=0,1,2,3\\\\\\\\)、\\\\\\\\(i=0,\\\\\\\\ldots,7\\\\\\\\)。AllReduce 求和后每个 rank 的第 \\\\\\\\(i\\\\\\\\) 项为 \\\\\\\\(600+4i\\\\\\\\)；AllGather 保留四个按 rank 排列的完整块。检查 ReduceScatter 时，让各 rank 输入 32 项并采用同一生成关系，归约后 rank \\\\\\\\(r\\\\\\\\) 得到索引 \\\\\\\\(8r\\\\\\\\) 到 \\\\\\\\(8r+7\\\\\\\\) 对应的八项。全零或全一输入可能掩盖重复、交换和位置错误；这个精确整数构造用于检查值与布局，不替代浮点或模型质量验证。\\\\n\\\\n局部原型可独立比较归约、拼接和 packing；还可以检验同形状但不同请求顺序、空专家、非整除维度及 padding。能够提前识别的参数矛盾应由适当的检查拒绝，未识别的问题仍须通过原型或实验暴露；不能把 benchmark 超时直接判为某一种根因。\\\\n\\\\n涉及相邻生产与消费时，可让某个生产者晚就绪，检查通信不会读未完成输入；让消费者晚完成，检查缓冲不会提前复用。在取消、单 rank 失败和新代次恢复中，旧结果不能进入新请求。故障注入在有界、隔离执行组中完成，保留最早失败及各 rank 最后已知状态。未完成或被终止的检查保留失败/不确定结果，不能因其他 rank 得到了数值就记为全组通过。\\\\n\\\\n完整系统应按 Task 原定的质量、性能与资源边界评估，所比较方案的任务条件应保持可比。生成服务可观察任务相关的 TTFT、ITL、尾延迟或合格吞吐；通信次数、暂存峰值、重排和慢 rank 等待用于检验当前机制，是否需要记录由问题决定，不额外成为所有 Task 的验收项。若局部 collective 更快但任务指标变差，可据此区分聚合等待、重排、GPU 资源竞争和慢 rank。局部、交互与完整任务的检查可以服务于不同阶段的探索，其结论限于实际覆盖范围。通信启动与带宽模型见 [通信拓扑](../hardware/topology-parallelism.md)，RDMA 完成和 GPU 可见性见 [传输协议](../hardware/transport-and-rdma.md)。\\\\n\\\\n<!-- infraagents:provenance -->\\\\n\\\\n## 来源与推导\\\\n\\\\n- [S-NCCL-GROUP：NCCL — \\\"category\\\": \\\"source_note\\\", \\\"content\\\": \\\"# S-CUDA-ASYNC：CUDA Programming Guide — Asynchronous Execution\\\\n\\\\n## 本地完整原文\\\\n\\\\n[完整原文](../../references/S-CUDA-ASYNC/reader.html) · [全文文本](../../references/S-CUDA-ASYNC/fulltext.txt)\\\\n\\\\n固定版本：CUDA 12.8.0。来源版本日期：2025-01-27；整理核对日期：2026-10-27。\\\\n\\\\n## 来源支持的机制与定义\\\\n\\\\nCUDA stream 表达设备工作的顺序，event 可以在不同执行队列间建立完成依赖。host 调用返回、设备工作开始和设备完成属于不同事件。\\\\n\\\\n固定归档是完整编程指南，本来源说明的异步主题包括§2.5的异步操作模型、§7.26的barrier、§7.27的异步复制和§7.28的多级pipeline。这里“异步”描述发出线程与执行完成的关系，不保证另一项计算一定在同时进行。\\\\n\\\\n§7.26.1–7.26.4区分CTA同步与拆开的arrive/wait：参与者在arrive之前的写入，经对应阶段的wait完成后对约定作用域的参与者可见；arrive本身不会等待其他线程。barrier初始化必须先于参与，每阶段的预期到达次数、实际参与者和阶段票据须一致。一个warp完成不自动等于整个CTA都不再访问某缓冲。\\\\n\\\\n§7.27.4说明复制完成之前，修改其全局源或读写共享目标会造成竞态；等候必须覆盖复制操作。§7.27.6.1说明CC 8.0所述硬件复制指令支持4/8/16字节粒度及相应对齐，错误的显式对齐证明会导致未定义行为。128字节对齐是该API的性能建议，不能把它混同于所有4字节复制的合法性条件。\\\\n\\\\n§7.27.6.3–7.27.6.6还区分warp实际批次序列与线程感知序列。分歧commit可能使一次线程等待覆盖比预想更多的批次；commit与arrive-on应按文档要求的参与/收敛关系组织。只数源程序中的“第几次wait”不能证明其覆盖的真实批次正确。\\\\n\\\\n§7.28.1–7.28.2用单级与多级pipeline区分“避免寄存器中转”与“隐藏复制延迟”：发出复制后立即等待可以得到正确结果，却没有由此形成计算与复制的重叠。多级组织还需启动预取、稳态消费与最后一批排空，并在消费者释放阶段后才允许生产者复用；零批次应直接处理，没有可等待的最后票据。\\\\n\\\\n## InfraAgents 如何据此推导\\\\n\\\\n本库据此解释负的“设备开始减 API 结束”、双缓冲时序、传输源的生命周期以及可真正隐藏的 host 工作。\\\\n\\\\n[GPU流水章节](../hardware/gpu-kernel-pipelines.md)据此独立构造一个双warp的SIMT GEMM与带代次输入槽。逻辑协议把复制完成、CTA可见性和两个warp最后读取分开；实际实现可以用不同同步对象承担这些依赖，但应逐项证明覆盖，不能把伪代码中的抽象票据当成已经选择正确CUDA API。\\\\n\\\\n该章节的L/I/C递推和6KiB容量案例是本库2026-10-27的假设算例，不是指南报告的某设备时间或容量。指南的架构规格由独立的[能力来源说明](S-CUDA-CAPABILITY.md)承担；不同CC的线程、共享存储与矩阵指令支持不应用一个8.x标签概括。\\\\n\\\\n## 适用边界\\\\n\\\\n机制与接口说明；不构成当前目标的性能或可达性证明。 原始版本、日期依据与归档范围见本地 provenance.json；版本日期不证明模型训练实际包含该资料。\\\\n\\\\n有限事件模型可以发现遗漏等候、提前复用或代次混淆，不能证明编译后指令、真实GPU的内存作用域、物理重叠或性能。跨CTA、跨stream、host/device之间使用相同概念时，同步对象和作用域必须分别核实。\\\\n\\\", \\\"excerpt_ranges\\\": [[0, 1610]], \\\"range_unit\\\": \\\"zero-based half-open characters in extracted text\\\", \\\"extracted_characters\\\": 1610, \\\"selected_characters\\\": 1610, \\\"extraction\\\": \\\"UTF-8 text\\\", \\\"selection_reason\\\": \\\"full extracted text fits allocation\\\"}, {\\\"path\\\": \\\"knowledge/algorithms/parallelism.md\\\", \\\"sha256\\\": \\\"161a883561e39371ea22a1430c385546c402db2f993d8a37c6f37e03e1e4bd17\\\", \\\"reading_scope\\\": \\\"full\\\", \\\"category\\\": \\\"related_chapter\\\", \\\"content\\\": \\\"# K-ALG-015：推理并行：张量分解、流水、专家与上下文\\\\n\\\\n并行策略改变张量归属和同步边界；选择依据是每阶段的计算、状态与通信分解。\\\\n\\\\n## 从一层矩阵乘法推导 TP\\\\n\\\\n线性层按输出通道切 W 时，各 rank 得到部分输出；后续若接受同样分片就可继续，若需要完整向量则要 gather。按输入通道切 W 时，每 rank 计算部分和，必须 reduce 才得到完整输出。Transformer 的列并行、行并行常成对组织，以减少不必要的 gather。\\\\n\\\\nTP 把权重和某些激活分散，但每层通信频繁。小 batch decode 的计算时间短，集合通信启动延迟容易占主导。KV heads 少于 TP 数时，还可能复制 KV 或采用不同分片，单卡 KV 不能机械地除以 TP。\\\\n\\\\n## PP 与 DP 的不同扩展目标\\\\n\\\\nPP 按层切模型，阶段之间传激活。多个微批可以填充流水；单请求逐 token 仍要走完整条流水，并等待下一 token。阶段不均衡和填充/排空产生气泡。PP 常有助于容纳大模型，不保证最低单请求延迟。\\\\n\\\\nDP 复制整个服务副本，各自处理不同请求，减少单请求跨卡同步。模型能放入单副本且请求足够多时，DP 可以提升总吞吐；但权重复制、前缀缓存分散和负载不均衡影响实际效率。前缀亲和路由又会改变各副本队列。\\\\n\\\\n## EP 与 CP 如何增加新轴\\\\n\\\\nEP 将不同专家放到不同 rank，路由后按专家 dispatch，再将输出 combine 回原 token。流量由 token 路由决定，热点专家可成为慢端。专家均衡的训练统计不保证某个在线小批的均衡。\\\\n\\\\nCP 将长上下文分片。attention 需要跨分片交换 K/V 或合并局部 softmax 统计；在线 softmax 的可合并性提供数学基础，但通信与临时空间仍有代价。窗口或稀疏可见性改变应交换的数据量。序列并行一词在不同实现中也可能指激活分片，阅读实现时应先确定到底哪一轴被切分。\\\\n\\\\n## 组合策略的容量与时间模型\\\\n\\\\n策略可以组合，例如节点内 TP、节点间 PP、请求间 DP、专家层 EP。每个并行组要说明成员、张量归属和操作顺序。算例中某层计算从 8 降到 3 单位，但新增不可隐藏通信 4，则净时间为 7；若再分卡只省 1 却增 2，就越过收益拐点。用实际通信路径的有效带宽和启动延迟代入，比按卡数线性估算可靠。\\\\n\\\\nprefill/decode 的最佳组合可能不同，阶段分离则增加跨布局 KV 转换。应把转换代价一起计入整体路径，避免得到两个局部最优而整体更慢的配置。\\\\n\\\\n## 逐层账本以张量所有者为起点\\\\n\\\\n设本轮有效 token 数为 T、hidden 维 d、元素字节 b，完整 hidden 为 A=Tdb 字节。对一个常见的 dense Transformer TP 组织，QKV 与 FFN 上投影按输出维切分，attention 输出投影和 FFN 下投影按输入维切分，后两者各需要一次归约得到完整 hidden。此描述是该候选的账本，融合、reduce-scatter 或 sequence parallel 会改变具体通信操作。\\\\n\\\\n| 对象/边界 | 本地内容 | 额外工作或缓冲 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| 层输入与 residual | 复制或明确分片的 T×d | 直到 residual 最后消费者完成 |\\\\n| Q/K/V 与 attention | 本 rank heads，KV 可能分片或复制 | 页表、量化参数、split attention workspace |\\\\n| Attention 输出投影 | 输入维分片产生 T×d 部分和 | 归约发送/接收及输出生存期 |\\\\n| FFN 或 MoE | 分片中间激活或按专家重排输入 | 门控中间量、专家 offsets、dispatch/combine |\\\\n| PP 边界 | 下阶段所需 hidden 与 metadata | 至少说明发送持有与接收预留；不能提前释放 |\\\\n| CP 边界 | 本地上下文及当前 query | 远端 K/V、局部 softmax 统计与合并输出 |\\\\n\\\\n理想 ring all-reduce 对一个 A 字节张量，每 rank 的发送量约为 2(p−1)A/p；接收为另一计量边界，不在“发送量”中再重复相加。上述两次归约合计每 rank 4(p−1)A/p。设 p=4、d=4096、b=2，T=1 时 A=8 KiB，两次发送共 24 KiB；T=2048 时 A=16 MiB，两次共 48 MiB。decode 虽 bytes 少，启动和同步仍发生两次；prefill 更可能受数据量约束。\\\\n\\\\nEP 按远端分派项计算 hidden 与返回输出流量，并加入索引/计数；同 token 的多个专家同设备时可研究去重传输，但返回聚合也要相容。CP 可交换 K/V 或合并局部 softmax 统计；不同方案的通信次数、查询复制及 workspace 不同。不能同时取一种方案的低流量与另一种方案的低暂存作为同一个候选。\\\\n\\\\n## 并行组组合与非整除维度\\\\n\\\\nTP、EP、DP、PP、CP 描述不同轴，但有些组在不同层复用同一批设备。应逐阶段写 rank→请求/token/head/专家/层区间映射，再求实际设备集合；TP4 与 EP4 可以在同 4 张卡的不同层执行，也可以被设计为不同轴，单写两个度数不能判断需 4 还是 16 张卡。\\\\n\\\\n非整除 hidden、FFN、head 或 vocabulary 维度可以通过不均匀分片、padding 或改变并行度处理，前提是后端支持。padding 不得进入有效词表采样、归约分母或模型输出；以均匀 shape 分配后静默舍弃尾部则不合法。GQA 需要全局 query→KV 映射，MLA 可能复制 latent，专家数非整除时则按每 rank 实际权重与最大负载计算，不能只看平均。\\\\n\\\\nPP 的阶段长度应按实际 attention、专家和通信成本而非仅按层数均分。对等时长阶段和充分独立微批，理想填充/排空气泡可以由流水槽数推导；逐 token 自回归、不同长度和慢阶段会破坏理想条件。通信重叠还要求有可计算的独立工作、足够缓冲，以及传输与计算没有把同一 HBM/链路/计算单元耗尽。\\\\n\\\\n## 场景：四卡 MLA/MoE 的三个候选\\\\n\\\\n以下全部为设计设定，不是 DeepSeek 型号规格或性能实测。任务为 16 个并发生成请求，prompt 为 2048–8192 token、输出目标 128 token，客户端 ITL 目标 40 ms；使用固定 MLA/MoE checkpoint 和 BF16 参考质量。资源为 4 张各 24 GiB 可供本任务使用的 GPU。假设权重共 48 GiB，其中 attention/其他 dense 部分 12 GiB、所有专家 36 GiB，模型 32 层、latent 512 维、RoPE key 64 维、状态 BF16。最长输入下，每请求逻辑缓存 288 MiB，16 请求共 4.5 GiB。\\\\n\\\\n候选 A 在四卡上做 TP4，专家矩阵也切分；候选 B 保持 attention TP4，MoE 改为 EP4；候选 C 为 PP2×TP2，每个阶段各持一半层。A/B 若各 rank 复制所服务请求的整份 MLA latent，则每卡权重 12 GiB、prompt 结束时 KV 4.5 GiB，另设 workspace/通信 2 GiB，主项 18.5 GiB。C 按等层切分使 prompt 结束时每卡 KV 2.25 GiB，在相同设定下主项 16.25 GiB，但逐请求增加跨阶段依赖及流水气泡。不能仅因 C 占用更低便断言它的 ITL 最小。\\\\n\\\\n为输出的 128 个 token 预留新增状态时，每请求再增 4.5 MiB；16 请求在完整 latent 复制的每个 rank 上增 72 MiB，即 0.0703125 GiB，A/B 主项成为 18.5703125 GiB。C 每 rank 只持一半层，增 36 MiB，主项为 16.28515625 GiB。这仍不是完整峰值保证：页尾、程序与运行时、量化元数据、加载和其他在途缓冲必须继续预留；若最后输出 token 尚不进入模型状态，预留可略多于实际使用，不能反过来省掉必要增长预算。\\\\n\\\\n| 候选 | 主要机会 | 需要区分的代价 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| A：全层 TP4 | 权重均匀分担，避免专家目的端偏斜 | 每层归约、小 expert 分片 GEMM、latent 复制 |\\\\n| B：attention TP4 + MoE EP4 | 专家矩阵更完整，grouped GEMM 与副本可调 | 分派/返回、热点专家、边界 token 所有权 |\\\\n| C：PP2×TP2 | 每卡状态下降，TP 组较小 | 阶段激活、气泡、慢阶段及单请求完整往返 |\\\\n\\\\nB 的 attention 输出在组内复制时，MoE 边界先为每个 token 选定唯一派发所有者；不能让四个 rank 都重复发送同一完整 hidden。设一层 top-2、16 token、hidden 4096、BF16，远端分派比例为 3/4，且未做同目的去重，则 24 个远端项各发送 8 KiB，返回同样大小，组级专家 dispatch/return 主流量合计 384 KiB，另有 metadata。所有者完成 combine 后，还要按下一 attention TP 的复制或分片契约重分布输出；相应广播、all-gather 或其他转换需另计，384 KiB 不是 B 的全部层通信量。这一小流量也可能受消息启动限制；在较大的 prefill 中，专家组长、字节和计算比又不同。\\\\n\\\\n若热点专家使一个 rank 成为慢端，可用额外 2 GiB/卡的设定预算研究冗余副本，此时 A/B 含输出增长的主项增到 20.5703125 GiB。副本放置只分担相同专家函数，路由仍保持模型规则。若用低位专家或 KV 量化腾出空间，应另检质量和执行格式；不能与 BF16 候选只比较 bytes。\\\\n\\\\n验证先用少量 token 对照单设备/逐专家逻辑参考的选中专家、权重、MLA 吸收结果和逐步 logits，再覆盖 nonuniform 路由、空专家、KV 页尾、TP 输出拼接、PP 不同长度与单 rank 失败。性能在相同到达轨迹和质量门槛下测每层关键路径、最慢 rank、真实通信/暂存、TTFT、ITL 和合格请求数。40 ms 是目标，容量算例不证明任何候选已经达到它。\\\\n\\\\n当拓扑连接快、batch 较大而 expert GEMM 更有效时，B 有机会胜出；低并发、消息启动昂贵或路由极偏时，A 可能更稳；最长上下文把复制 KV 推至容量边界时，C 的较低状态量可能成为必要条件，但需更多独立请求填流水。若模型能在更小副本内完整容纳，请求级复制又应进入候选。选择通过这些可区分的瓶颈反转，而非固定认定更多并行轴总是更好。\\\\n\\\\n<!-- infraagents:provenance -->\\\\n\\\\n## 来源与推导\\\\n\\\\n- [S-NCCL-COLLECTIVE：NCCL — Collective \\\"related_chapter\\\", \\\"content\\\": \\\"# K-HW-002：通信拓扑：从 Rank 组到瓶颈链路\\\\n\\\\n多卡性能由数据经过的实际路径决定；rank 数只是拓扑模型的一部分。\\\\n\\\\n## 拓扑是带容量的图\\\\n\\\\n节点包含设备、CPU NUMA 域和网卡，边包含设备直连、PCIe、交换结构和跨节点网络。边的延迟、有效带宽、双向能力和共享上行影响集体操作。两个 GPU 虽然都支持 peer access，也可能经过带宽较弱或共享的路径；API 可达性不是等带宽保证。\\\\n\\\\n一次通信可粗略写为 α＋n/β，α 表示启动/协调延迟，β 是路径有效带宽。小消息主要受 α，大消息主要受 β。多个流共享瓶颈边时，每流可获得的 β 下降；因此单链路 microbenchmark 不自动预测 all-to-all。\\\\n\\\\n## 集合操作怎样使用链路\\\\n\\\\nring all-reduce 在理想均匀 \\\\\\\\(P\\\\\\\\) ranks 下，每 rank 的发送量为 \\\\\\\\(2(P-1)n/P\\\\\\\\)。这里 \\\\\\\\(n\\\\\\\\) 是每 rank 输入字节数，reduce-scatter 与 all-gather 共 \\\\\\\\(2(P-1)\\\\\\\\) 轮。若每轮启动成本为 \\\\\\\\(\\\\\\\\alpha\\\\\\\\)，单向有效带宽为 \\\\\\\\(\\\\\\\\beta\\\\\\\\)，各块均匀、带宽稳定且无额外争用，并假设全双工发送与接收可以并发，则\\\\n\\\\n\\\\\\\\[\\\\nT_{\\\\\\\\mathrm{ring}}\\\\\\\\approx 2(P-1)\\\\\\\\alpha+\\\\\\\\frac{2(P-1)n}{P\\\\\\\\beta}.\\\\n\\\\\\\\]\\\\n\\\\n该带宽项以每 rank 发送量和单向带宽计算，不再将同时发生的接收重复加到时间里。设 \\\\\\\\(P=4\\\\\\\\)、\\\\\\\\(\\\\\\\\alpha=5\\\\\\\\) 微秒、\\\\\\\\(\\\\\\\\beta=40\\\\\\\\) GiB/s：\\\\\\\\(n=16\\\\\\\\) MiB 时约为 0.61594 ms，\\\\\\\\(n=8\\\\\\\\) KiB 时约为 30.286 微秒，其中启动项已占 30 微秒。这些都是解释公式的设定值；小消息字节少，仍可能需要降低调用次数或依赖长度。\\\\n\\\\n树形、分层或其他算法改变延迟和流量组织。这个理想 ring 模型不代表某次 NCCL 一定选择 ring，也没有计入跨层网络争用、packing、暂存和慢 rank。要比较端到端收益，还需要把不能隐藏的通信接到实际消费者的关键路径。\\\\n\\\\nTP 每层常有同步，小 batch 更容易暴露 α；EP 的 all-to-all 受路由偏斜和双向竞争影响；PP 更接近阶段间点对点；P/D 分离主要搬较大状态。把高频 TP 放在强互联域、把较低频通信放在更远层级，是可由这些模型推导的候选，而非所有部署的固定规则。\\\\n\\\\n## NUMA 和网卡亲和\\\\n\\\\n主机线程、pinned buffers 和网卡若落在远端 NUMA 域，数据可能额外穿越 CPU 互联。GPU 直连路径可减少某些主机搬运，但控制面与分配仍可能受 CPU 影响。通信发生在哪个进程、设备和接口，应与 rank 映射共同记录。\\\\n\\\\n通信与计算重叠需要数据先就绪、接收方及时发起、硬件资源允许并行。独立 stream 只是提交关系，若两者争同一内存带宽，重叠也可能使各自更慢。判断收益看关键路径缩短，而非时间线上颜色相交。\\\\n\\\\n## 每条共享边的流量要有明确方向\\\\n\\\\n每 rank 发送、接收以及端点内存读写是不同计量边界。理想 ring 的常用字节公式不能在没有说明时既算发送又重复算接收；全双工链路与共享上行也有不同容量约束。按实际经过的边统计 TP、EP、P/D、缓存副本与制品加载，可以找到单个操作微基准看不到的竞争。\\\\n\\\\nGPU 直接路径的可达性还受注册方式、驱动、PCIe 根/交换结构和平台支持影响。对某个设备对测得的带宽不能替代其他 GPU/NIC 配对；主机中转和直接路径分别测量，记录 CPU、NUMA 与接收端处理是否进入关键路径。\\\\n\\\\n## 以真实消息形态校准\\\\n\\\\n小而频繁的控制/集合消息更容易暴露启动与同步，大 KV 或权重流更容易暴露带宽与拥塞。扫描消息大小、并发流、双向传输和计算同时运行的情况，观察实际 bytes、队列与用户时延，而非只看总网络利用率。\\\\n\\\\n热点缓存节点可以成为所有计算实例共同的瓶颈；将请求分散到更多 GPU 反而可能增加对它的读取。副本与迁移的拓扑选择，应与 [全局缓存](../system-semantics/distributed-kv-store.md) 和 [路由](../algorithms/routing-and-migration.md) 联合推导。\\\\n\\\\n<!-- infraagents:provenance -->\\\\n\\\\n## 来源与推导\\\\n\\\\n- [S-CUDA-TOPOLOGY：CUDA Programming Guide — Programming Systems with Multiple GPUs](../sources/S-CUDA-TOPOLOGY.md)：多 GPU K-SYS-009：分布式状态迁移：身份、传输与提交点\\\\n\\\\n状态迁移是一项所有权和可见性协议；字节到达只有在布局和版本被共同解释后才成为可用模型状态。\\\\n\\\\n## 迁移对象的描述\\\\n\\\\n一个状态包需要模型/权重/adapter 身份、逻辑前缀、位置规则、各层状态几何、dtype/量化 scales、分片方式和有效范围。网络地址只是运输位置，不是内容身份；源指针值在目标进程通常没有相同含义。\\\\n\\\\n发送方和接收方 TP/PP 布局不同，状态可能需要切片、汇集或重排。KV 布局 NHD/HND 不同还可能增加转置。传输协议可以选统一中间布局以减少组合数，代价是额外转换；也可选特定端点对的直接路径，提高效率但增加适配种类。\\\\n\\\\n## 从预留到发布\\\\n\\\\n目标预留资源，源开始传输，目标逐块确认完成，最后将完整状态以某个执行代次发布给调度器。发布前的页不能被新 query 读取；发布后源才能按约定释放最后责任。部分失败需要回滚未提交预留，或记录可恢复的已到达区间。\\\\n\\\\n如果按层流水接收，目标可以在所需层状态完成后推进，但整个执行仍需保证后续层及时可用及失败能一致处理。优化传输与计算重叠不改变“读之前完成、释放之前无人使用”的基础关系。\\\\n\\\\n## 内容复用与重试\\\\n\\\\n目标已有相同前缀时可只接缺失状态，判断依据必须包含所有影响中间值的条件。重复网络提交需要幂等传输 ID，避免重复记引用或将晚到旧代次覆盖新状态。对混合模型，复用单位是共同恢复位置所需的状态包，并非任意 token 区间。\\\\n\\\\n迁移总收益为避免的重算或排队成本，减去序列化、转换、传输和接管成本。迁移可以改善资源均衡，也可能把网络变成新瓶颈。将资源归属和提交点先定义清楚，才能安全探索这些策略。\\\\n\\\\n## 把网络完成接到模型消费之前\\\\n\\\\n[传输协议](../hardware/transport-and-rdma.md) 区分提交、CQE、GPU 可见性和应用接管。目的空间存在、目录已登记或 NIC 报告完成，都不能独立证明下一次 forward 可以读取整个状态包。每个消费者依赖所需范围的完整性和相应执行平台的可见性。\\\\n\\\\n传输 ID 标识逻辑对象和目标范围，尝试代次区分重复或迟到的操作。重复到达同一区间不能重复增加引用；目标已回收并重新分配后，旧写入必须停止或失效。发送 staging 的最后使用与源端最后恢复副本的释放分开处理。\\\\n\\\\n## 活跃状态与失败窗口\\\\n\\\\nappend-only KV 可以分阶段复制旧前缀并追赶增量；窗口覆盖、递归状态和投机回滚则需要其他快照条件。目标每阶段预留容量，源完成/取消或目的失败时撤销未提交工作。最后的停止、追赶、授权与恢复位置要形成同一条时序。\\\\n\\\\n对确认消息丢失、源端退出和目标重启，明确由哪个权威记录判断接管是否已生效；不能让新旧两端分别按超时同时提交。若没有足够证据恢复，选择重算或明确失败，比使用部分未知状态继续生成更符合既定语义。\\\\n\\\\n验证逐项覆盖状态几何不同、TP/PP 重分片、量化元数据、部分范围、旧模型版本和重试。性能同时报告完整迁移时间、可见停顿、转换及临时峰值，不能只给最小尾部复制时间。\\\\n\\\\n<!-- infraagents:provenance -->\\\\n\\\\n## 来源与推导\\\\n\\\\n- [S-DISTSERVE：DistServe](../sources/S-DISTSERVE.md)：DistServe 将 需要接收侧按相应协议提供接收资源；普通 RDMA WRITE 不能假定自动产生目标应用所等待的接收完成。带 immediate 的操作、传输类型与硬件能力也有具体限制，应按固定版本接口选用。[rdma-core v54.0](../sources/S-RDMA.md) 的原始 man pages 给出这些契约。\\\\n\\\\n批量提交也可能只完成了前面一部分 WR 的提交，遇到首个可立即检测的错误时停止；已经提交的请求仍需结算。post 成功不是 CQE 成功。收到完成后先检查状态，失败完成中的部分字段不具有成功时的含义。\\\\n\\\\n## 两个实例的逐事件时序\\\\n\\\\n| 阶段 | 源实例 A | 目标实例 B |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| 准备 | 固定待发对象与逻辑代次 | 预留接收范围，建立有效注册/接收描述 |\\\\n| 协商 | 获取合法目的位置和传输 ID | 返回位置、范围、版本约定与容量结果 |\\\\n| 提交 | 发起对应 WR，保持在途保护 | 按实际操作类型等待数据与通知 |\\\\n| 传输完成 | 检查本地完成与错误 | 确认所需范围完整并建立消费者可见性 |\\\\n| 应用提交 | 保留协议要求的最后恢复责任 | 验证模型/布局/长度，发布可执行状态并确认 |\\\\n| 回收 | 在访问结束及责任移交后释放相应对象 | 消费者结束后允许复用目的槽 |\\\\n\\\\n发送 staging 可以在其规定的本地使用结束后复用，而源端最后一份可恢复 KV 可能仍需保留到应用接管确认；不能把这两种对象的生命周期合并。固定 verbs 文档还明确 inline 发送有特殊的本地缓冲复用规则，应按实际操作解释，不能套用统一等待条件。\\\\n\\\\n## CQE、通知和应用确认\\\\n\\\\nCQE 对应具体工作完成；完成通道事件通知需要进一步 poll 并检查 CQ。通知可能与实际 poll 交错，不能假设每个通知恰好对应一个尚未消费的 CQE。一次性通知重置、事件确认和 CQ 容量也参与正确性；处理过慢导致 CQ overrun 后，不能继续把队列当作正常运行。\\\\n\\\\npolling 可减少部分唤醒延迟但占用 CPU，事件等待可节省空闲资源但引入调度成本。批量 poll 与适度合并提交可以摊薄控制成本，又会改变尾延迟与在途容量。网络传输的完成保证应按 transport、flags 和 MR 属性理解；它不等同于接收方已经完成模型计算或提交外部响应。\\\\n\\\\n## GPUDirect 还需要 GPU 可见性\\\\n\\\\n[GPUDirect RDMA 的 CUDA 12.8 固定文档](../sources/S-GPUDIRECT.md) §2.7 说明，外部设备写入 GPU 映射与 GPU 正在运行的 kernel 之间需要明确的排序关系。NIC 完成不能被任意一个并发 kernel 当作读取新数据的充分条件；应先确认所需写入完成，再通过该版本支持的 CUDA 同步/提交关系启动依赖消费者。\\\\n\\\\n直接路径还受 GPU/NIC、PCIe 拓扑、驱动、注册方式和平台支持约束；Unified Memory、物理共享内存与 GPUDirect 也不是同一承诺。比较显式主机 staging 与直接路径时，分别计入复制、注册/BAR 资源、CPU 控制开销及共享链路。可以建立路径不表示任意方向都有相同带宽。\\\\n\\\\n## 小消息、大状态与共享拓扑\\\\n\\\\n消息时间可先写为 α+D/B，但多个消息、并发流和分片会共享 NIC、交换链路、PCIe 与主存。小 metadata 可能受 α 和 CPU 处理支配，大 KV 更接近带宽限制。设定 512 MiB、有效带宽 20 GiB/s，纯传输下界为 25 ms；握手、布局转换与队列还未计入。\\\\n\\\\n将 TP 通信、P/D 状态传输、缓存副本复制与制品加载放到同一拓扑图中，检查共享边的总需求。更深发送队列可以隐藏延迟，也可能加剧拥塞、拖延控制消息或占满目的容量。GPU 与 NIC 亲和、主机 NUMA 和接收方及时消费都影响最终路径。\\\\n\\\\n## 取消、空工作和失败验证\\\\n\\\\n没有 payload 的分片仍需按上层协议表达明确的空范围或完成状态；集合通信的参与顺序也不能因本地工作为空而随意跳过。取消先停止新增提交，再结算已提交 WR 和目的预留；超时本身不证明远端从未写入，因此重试要带同一逻辑传输身份与新的尝试代次。\\\\n\\\\n验证包括提交部分失败、CQ 错误、接收资源不足、源退出、目的缓冲重用、通知与 poll 交错，以及 GPU 消费早于可见性的受控反例。记录实际字节、错误状态、排队和最后使用者，避免用“网络通了”替代完整状态传输协议。\\\\n\\\\n<!-- infraagents:provenance -->\\\\n\\\\n## 来源与推导\\\\n\\\\n- [S-RDMA：rdma-core v54.0 — registration, work requests, completion queues \\\"knowledge/system-semantics/serving-recovery.md\\\", \\\"sha256\\\": \\\"f551fa1f1e6213469c856a880839eefff504fb39f4dd692000b2df80a20a7f5e\\\", \\\"reading_scope\\\": \\\"full\\\", \\\"category\\\": \\\"related_chapter\\\", \\\"content\\\": \\\"# K-SYS-014：推理服务恢复：提交边界、执行组与重试身份\\\\n\\\\n恢复首先要确定哪些工作已经成为外部可依赖的结果、哪些状态仍可信，以及谁有权继续提交。检测到超时或重新启动进程，都不能独立回答这些问题。\\\\n\\\\n## 三个边界分别记录\\\\n\\\\n计算边界表示哪些输入位置已经生成完整模型状态；确认边界表示投机/搜索后哪些 token 属于保留路径；外部提交边界表示服务已经按协议发布的内容。它们可能不同。prefill 末行可以产生一个 token，但该 token 自身的 KV 未必已经计算；网络发送返回也不等于客户端已消费。\\\\n\\\\n恢复描述至少包含请求与尝试身份、模型/adapter/输入配置、已确认 token、可重建的共同状态位置，以及需要继续的随机、grammar 和输出状态。只保存 KV 字节无法恢复任意请求；只保存 token 也不自动恢复任意递归模型、分支状态或已经发生的外部动作。\\\\n\\\\n可重算的模型状态与不可重复的业务结果分开处理。固定前缀可以帮助重建 KV，但跨 backend 重算是否逐位一致取决于数值契约。若协议需要断线续传，应有明确的游标、去重与确认规则；否则应报告失败或重新请求，不能默认已经获得“恰好一次”交付。\\\\n\\\\n## 故障矩阵决定恢复路线\\\\n\\\\n| 故障位置 | 首先确认 | 合法的恢复或终止方式 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| 输入处理进程失败 | 是否已准入、输入是否可重放 | 从固定输入重做未提交部分，清理预留 |\\\\n| 单个计算 rank 退出 | 执行组是否还拥有一致状态 | 停止受影响组，从共同提交点重建或明确失败 |\\\\n| KV 传输部分完成 | 目标范围和源副本的有效性 | 撤销未提交目标，重传或从可恢复前缀重算 |\\\\n| 源在接管期间失效 | 目标是否完成且已获提交权 | 按协议完成接管；否则使用其他副本或重建 |\\\\n| 磁盘/压缩读取失败 | 哪些对象可重建、哪些记录必须保留 | 失效对应缓存；不能把未完成解码当作可用状态 |\\\\n| 客户端断线 | 哪些内容已发出、协议能否确认消费 | 依协议取消、续传或失败，不猜测客户端进度 |\\\\n\\\\n每条路线同时说明输出处理和资源清理。最后一个错误通常只是连锁超时，诊断要保留最早失败、rank 状态、操作序号和已经完成的范围。\\\\n\\\\n## 执行组恢复与单请求恢复不同\\\\n\\\\nTP/EP 等组内的 ranks 必须执行相容的操作序列。一个 rank 的失败不能让其他 ranks 继续把局部结果当作完整层；请求取消也不能让某个 rank 单独跳过 collective。根据固定通信库的错误处理契约终止或重建受影响资源，并让调度器停止向失效组提交新工作。\\\\n\\\\n重建可以重新加载模型、重建 communicator/执行上下文，再恢复合法状态。已经失效的设备句柄、注册区、页表和图对象不能仅因地址看起来相同就继续使用。较大的执行组能处理更大模型，但故障影响范围与恢复时间也随组织方式改变。\\\\n\\\\n## 迁移期间只允许一份提交权\\\\n\\\\n[Llumnix v1](../sources/S-LLUMNIX.md) §4.2 描述了分阶段复制、目标预留和迁移异常处理；它利用 append-only KV 隐藏部分复制时间。窗口覆盖、递归状态和可回滚分支不自动满足这个前提，需冻结或另行保存恢复版本。\\\\n\\\\n应用需要明确源端何时停止提交、目标何时获得提交权，以及确认丢失时如何判断。新尝试带独立代次，旧节点的迟到消息不能重新获得当前请求的提交权。多个控制节点也必须提供一致的授权规则，不能各自根据本地超时决定同时接管。\\\\n\\\\n最后源副本释放与目标提交之间的窗口必须有恢复依据。可以保留源直到确认、依赖已经完整的其他副本，或允许从持久输入重算；选择取决于故障模型与成本。内存内迁移本身不能保证机器同时失效后仍有持久恢复能力。\\\\n\\\\n## 重试预算和过载反馈\\\\n\\\\n重试可能与原任务同时消耗资源，且常发生在系统已过载时。控制并发尝试、总时间预算和退避，避免把一次网络或节点故障变成请求放大。幂等传输 ID 处理重复范围，逻辑请求 ID 处理重复提交；它们是不同层次。\\\\n\\\\n恢复后需重新检查 deadline、质量和容量。如果剩余时间已无法满足任务，不应无条件重试直到某次成功再隐藏此前失败。故障恢复实验与正常稳态性能分开报告，也要度量恢复期间对其他请求造成的影响。\\\\n\\\\n## 验证可观察的不变量\\\\n\\\\n在预留后、部分传输后、目标发布前后、输出提交前后分别注入失败。检查请求终态唯一、输出序号连续、旧代次不覆盖新状态、未完成缓冲不被复用，以及资源最终回到声明的稳态基线。对随机生成，明确要求相同轨迹还是相同分布；对可重算缓存，检查恢复位置和其他状态族的交集。\\\\n\\\\n低失败率、短请求可能适合失败后重做；长请求、严格交互连续性或昂贵状态可能需要更多检查点、副本与接管协议。多种方案都要把恢复成本计入 SLO 与容量，而不是只比较无故障时的速度。\\\\n\\\\n<!-- infraagents:provenance -->\\\\n\\\\n## 来源与推导\\\\n\\\\n- [S-LLUMNIX：Llumnix](../sources/S-LLUMNIX.md)：§4 通过分阶段 append-only KV K-ALG-023：请求路由与迁移：命中收益、排队和追赶条件\\\\n\\\\n路由选择请求去哪里执行，迁移允许在实际状态增长后重新选择。两者应最小化与任务有关的完整代价，并保持输入、状态和输出提交的一致性。\\\\n\\\\n## 命中最多的节点未必最早完成\\\\n\\\\n候选节点的估计成本可以包括排队、未命中输入计算、远端读取/转换、执行阶段和接管开销。缓存身份先满足语义，再比较性能；过期目录与滞后的负载报告不能直接作为执行许可。\\\\n\\\\n设定 A 有本地前缀，排队 100 ms、剩余计算 10 ms；B 无缓存但无排队，重算 80 ms；C 排队 10 ms，远端取得正确状态需 40 ms、剩余计算 10 ms。对应估计为 110、80、60 ms，C 才是这一设定下较好的选择。若 C 的目标容量或状态身份检查失败，它必须退出合法候选集合，不能仅凭最低分数继续接收。\\\\n\\\\n最短请求队列、最少 token、最少内存占用与最短完成时间也不等价。长历史会增加 KV 和 attention，长输出决定未来驻留，prefill 与 decode 的资源需求不同。未知输出可以使用有范围的估计，但实际准入仍需检查当前资源和近期增量。\\\\n\\\\n## 全局观察与本地决定\\\\n\\\\n[Mooncake](../sources/S-MOONCAKE.md) §5–6 将缓存局部性、池负载与 SLO 联合调度；[Llumnix](../sources/S-LLUMNIX.md) §4 将全局实例配对与本地请求选择分开，并用虚拟使用量表达多种调度目标。这些是减少全局跟踪成本的候选组织，不保证一个内存标量就能预测所有延迟。\\\\n\\\\n多个路由器同时看到同一个空闲节点，可能把下一批请求全部送过去。预留、局部再检查和适度分散可以减少这种竞争，但需要说明何时释放预留与如何拒绝过时决定。负载报告越稀疏，控制开销越低，决策误差可能越大；频繁迁移又会放大网络和状态成本。\\\\n\\\\n## 活跃迁移的追赶条件\\\\n\\\\n对可冻结旧前缀且仅追加新状态的请求，可以一边复制旧状态一边生成新 token，随后复制增量，最后短暂停止源端推进并移交尾部。对可变窗口、递归覆盖或投机回滚，必须另行定义每一阶段的快照边界。\\\\n\\\\n设初始状态 D、持续新增速度 g、有效复制速度 B，忽略其他开销，首阶段耗时 D/B，产生增量 D·g/B；下一阶段的增量继续乘 g/B。只有 B>g 才有这种几何收敛机会。实际链路竞争、不同块开销与生成速度波动都可能打破估计，因此应有停止追赶、暂停复制或中止迁移的条件。\\\\n\\\\n设定一个请求组有 1000 MiB 待迁移，新增 10 MiB/s，复制 100 MiB/s。前三阶段分别约 10、1、0.1 秒，剩余增量为 1 MiB，最终停顿复制约 10 ms，另加提交开销。总迁移时间约 11.11 秒，不能用 10 ms 停顿代表整个迁移免费。如果可用带宽降到 8 MiB/s，小于新增速度，继续原策略不会追上。\\\\n\\\\n## 目标容量、输出与网络的共同预算\\\\n\\\\n目标在每阶段接收前预留必要空间；源在迁移中完成、取消或被抢占时，目的端清理未提交预留。移交时明确最后确认 token、已计算状态与已经发布输出，防止新旧端重复发送或遗漏。数据传输和请求接管的责任见 [恢复协议](../system-semantics/serving-recovery.md)。\\\\n\\\\n迁移可以释放某实例空间、减轻干扰、支持优先级或排空，但同时会占用目的容量和网络。搬走一个大请求可能比重新路由未来请求更昂贵；搬走多个小请求也可能增加控制开销。比较预计避免的等待/抢占成本与迁移全过程成本，并保留足够收益余量，避免围绕预测噪声来回迁移。\\\\n\\\\n## 热点副本与优先级\\\\n\\\\n复制热门前缀把后续请求分散到多个实例，可以同时改善命中与排队；也可能将有限缓存装满同一热点，挤出其他高价值对象。高优先级请求可通过迁走同驻请求获得资源，但被迁请求的等待和 SLO 仍需要记录。总体 goodput 上升不代表每个租户都改善。\\\\n\\\\n验证使用热点逐渐变化、长短请求混合、负载报告延迟和带宽下降的轨迹；同时观察排队、重算、迁移字节、停顿、拒绝、内存碎片与各类 SLO。若节省的计算小于新增排队，或迁移长期追不上，路由应允许回到简单分散或本地重算方案。\\\\n\\\\n<!-- infraagents:provenance -->\\\\n\\\\n## 来源与推导\\\\n\\\\n- \\\"full\\\", \\\"category\\\": \\\"related_chapter\\\", \\\"content\\\": \\\"# K-TOOLS-005：失败分析：最早偏离、最小复现与机制归因\\\\n\\\\n失败记录的价值在于还原系统从哪一个状态开始偏离预期，并区分输入、实现、资源和外部环境。\\\\n\\\\n## 不同失败有不同语义\\\\n\\\\n无法启动进程、运行返回非零、超时、被信号终止、数值检查失败和 SLO 未达标不是同一事件。前四种解释执行状态，数值失败解释任务函数，SLO 失败解释性能可行性。完整 stdout/stderr、退出状态、环境与输入身份提供追溯基础。\\\\n\\\\n设备错误可能异步在后续同步点出现，traceback 的最后一行未必是错误的首次触发位置。分布式场景中一个 rank 的首个 OOM 可能表现为其他 ranks 通信超时。保留全组原始事件并定位最早相关偏离，优于只读取最后一条报错。\\\\n\\\\n## 最小复现保留什么\\\\n\\\\n最小化应保留触发机制：页边界错误需保留跨页访问，取消竞态需保留在途与重用，数值问题需保留敏感形状和精度，编译错误需保留触发 guard 的条件。删除所有并发后错误消失，不代表已经复现了原问题。\\\\n\\\\n可以按输入、状态、执行并发和环境四轴逐步缩减，每次说明移除后哪种关系不再存在。确定性种子有助于固定随机输入，但异步竞态往往需要记录调度/代次而不只固定 seed。\\\\n\\\\n## 修复形成什么知识\\\\n\\\\n当修复改变了某条依赖或布局关系，并使预期现象恢复，记录这条关系及其条件。临时路径、一次机器不足和偶发网络故障通常留在案例。反复出现且可解释的模式才适合提炼成机制知识，例如“分配器不知道跨 stream 使用会提前重用地址”。\\\\n\\\\n## 将故障注入绑定到状态边界\\\\n\\\\n故障实验先定义预期契约和恢复点，再选择能区分原因的注入。下表是一组验证设计，不表示这些实验已经在目标服务运行。\\\\n\\\\n| 故障 | 保留的触发条件 | 需要的证据与判定 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| 主机 OOM/内存节流 | 限额与加载峰值、页缓存或 IPC 同时存在 | cgroup 有效限制、memory.events、最早失败分配与进程终态；区分 memory.high 压力和 OOM kill |\\\\n| GPU 容量不足 | 权重、KV 增长、adapter 换入或 workspace 峰值 | 各对象有效/预留/在途字节与首次失败；不能只看请求结束后的空闲显存 |\\\\n| 存储超时/截断 | 正在读取一个固定版本的特定分片或范围 | 已完成范围、后端错误、发布状态与缓冲引用；未完成数据不能进入计算 |\\\\n| 部分 rank 退出 | 全组已提交的操作顺序与动态 batch 元数据 | 所有 rank 的最早事件、失败传播和共同终态；通信超时可能只是后果 |\\\\n| 网络断开或确认丢失 | 已交付位置、在途状态和唯一提交权 | 重试/接管记录、是否重复内容、旧代次是否失效及迟到操作是否安全 |\\\\n| 滚动更新中失败 | 新旧版本同时存在，部分实例已切流 | 版本绑定、实际就绪数、排空请求和回退后的容量；不能只检查进程重新启动 |\\\\n\\\\n资源故障分为环境限额、容量设计不足和泄漏，不应一律通过扩大资源后宣布修复。I/O 超时还要区分排队、设备服务、网络传输、重试与应用等待；超时阈值变大只改变表象，未必解释根因。\\\\n\\\\n## 重复、压力与恢复的证据\\\\n\\\\n在隔离测试环境内使用相同输入与状态边界比较故障前、故障中、恢复后；故障概率或持续时间改变时，保留相同 offered workload。统计失败请求、拒绝、恢复时间、无效计算和受影响的其他租户，不把失败样本从吞吐分母中删掉。\\\\n\\\\n反复注入取消、分片失败与重试后停止新输入，检查私有状态与在途引用结束，共享池回到已定义的空闲基线。允许保留的编译缓存、arena 或公共权重应有解释；无法解释的逐轮增长才是进一步查找泄漏的直接信号。\\\\n\\\\n修复验证同时包含触发故障的小例、仍保留并发关系的压力例和未参与诊断的代表负载。修复若改变重试、路由或缓存策略，还要检查输出提交与版本身份，防止把崩溃变成静默错误。一个故障点通过只能支持该路径与条件，不能被写成全部故障恢复已经正确。\\\\n\\\\n<!-- infraagents:provenance Calls\\\\n¶\\\\nGroup functions (ncclGroupStart/ncclGroupEnd) can be used to merge multiple calls into one. This is needed for\\\\nthree purposes: managing multiple GPUs from one thread (to avoid deadlocks), aggregating communication operations\\\\nto improve performance, or merging multiple send/receive point-to-point operations (see\\\\nPoint-to-point communication\\\\nsection). All three usages can be combined together, with one exception : calls to\\\\nncclCommInitRank()\\\\ncannot be merged with others.\\\\nManagement Of Multiple GPUs From One Thread\\\\n¶\\\\nWhen a single thread is managing multiple devices, group semantics must be used.\\\\nThis is because every NCCL call may have to block, waiting for other threads/ranks to arrive, before effectively posting the NCCL operation on the given stream. Hence, a simple loop on multiple devices like shown below could block on the first call waiting for the other ones:\\\\nfor\\\\n(\\\\nint\\\\ni\\\\n=\\\\n0\\\\n;\\\\ni\\\\n<\\\\nnLocalDevs\\\\n;\\\\ni\\\\n++\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\nncclAllReduce\\\\n(...,\\\\ncomm\\\\n[\\\\ni\\\\n],\\\\nstream\\\\n[\\\\ni\\\\n]);\\\\n}\\\\nTo define that these calls are part of the same collective operation, ncclGroupStart and ncclGroupEnd should be used:\\\\nncclGroupStart\\\\n();\\\\nfor\\\\n(\\\\nint\\\\ni\\\\n=\\\\n0\\\\n;\\\\ni\\\\n<\\\\nnLocalDevs\\\\n;\\\\ni\\\\n++\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\nncclAllReduce\\\\n(...,\\\\ncomm\\\\n[\\\\ni\\\\n],\\\\nstream\\\\n[\\\\ni\\\\n]);\\\\n}\\\\nncclGroupEnd\\\\n();\\\\nThis will tell NCCL to treat all calls between ncclGroupStart and ncclGroupEnd as a single call to many devices.\\\\nCaution: When called inside a group, stream operations (like ncclAllReduce) can return without having enqueued the\\\\noperation on the stream. Stream operations like cudaStreamSynchronize can therefore be called only after ncclGroupEnd\\\\nreturns.\\\\nGroup calls must also be used to create a communicator when one thread manages more than one device:\\\\nncclGroupStart\\\\n();\\\\nfor\\\\n(\\\\nint\\\\ni\\\\n=\\\\n0\\\\n;\\\\ni\\\\n<\\\\nnLocalDevs\\\\n;\\\\ni\\\\n++\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\ncudaSetDevice\\\\n(\\\\ndevice\\\\n[\\\\ni\\\\n]);\\\\nncclCommInitRank\\\\n(\\\\ncomms\\\\n+\\\\ni\\\\n,\\\\nnranks\\\\n,\\\\ncommId\\\\n,\\\\nrank\\\\n[\\\\ni\\\\n]);\\\\n}\\\\nncclGroupEnd\\\\n();\\\\nNote: Contrary to NCCL 1.x, there is no need to set the CUDA device before every NCCL communication call within a group,\\\\nbut it is still needed when calling ncclCommInitRank within a group.\\\\nRelated links:\\\\nncclGroupStart()\\\\nncclGroupEnd()\\\\nAggregated Operations (2.2 and later)\\\\n¶\\\\nThe group semantics can also be used to have multiple collective operations performed within a single NCCL launch. This\\\\nis useful for reducing the launch overhead, in other words, latency, as it only occurs once for multiple operations.\\\\nInit functions cannot be aggregated with other init functions, nor with communication functions.\\\\nAggregation of collective operations can be done simply by having multiple calls to NCCL within a ncclGroupStart /\\\\nncclGroupEnd section.\\\\nIn the following example, we launch one broadcast and two allReduce operations together as a single NCCL launch.\\\\nncclGroupStart\\\\n();\\\\nncclBroadcast\\\\n(\\\\nsendbuff1\\\\n,\\\\nrecvbuff1\\\\n,\\\\ncount1\\\\n,\\\\ndatatype\\\\n,\\\\nroot\\\\n,\\\\ncomm\\\\n,\\\\nstream\\\\n);\\\\nncclAllReduce\\\\n(\\\\nsendbuff2\\\\n,\\\\nrecvbuff2\\\\n,\\\\ncount2\\\\n,\\\\ndatatype\\\\n,\\\\ncomm\\\\n,\\\\nstream\\\\n);\\\\nncclAllReduce\\\\n(\\\\nsendbuff3\\\\n,\\\\nrecvbuff3\\\\n,\\\\ncount3\\\\n,\\\\ndatatype\\\\n,\\\\ncomm\\\\n,\\\\nstream\\\\n);\\\\nncclGroupEnd\\\\n();\\\\nIt is permitted to combine aggregation with multi-GPU launch and use different communicators in a group launch\\\\nas shown in the Management Of Multiple GPUs From One Thread topic.  When combining multi-GPU launch and aggregation,\\\\nncclGroupStart and ncclGroupEnd can be either used once or at each level. The following example groups the allReduce\\\\noperations from different layers and on multiple CUDA devices :\\\\nncclGroupStart\\\\n();\\\\nfor\\\\n(\\\\nint\\\\ni\\\\n=\\\\n0\\\\n;\\\\ni\\\\n<\\\\nnlayers\\\\n;\\\\ni\\\\n++\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\nncclGroupStart\\\\n();\\\\nfor\\\\n(\\\\nint\\\\ng\\\\n=\\\\n0\\\\n;\\\\ng\\\\n<\\\\nngpus\\\\n;\\\\ng\\\\n++\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\nncclAllReduce\\\\n(\\\\nsendbuffs\\\\n[\\\\ng\\\\n]\\\\n+\\\\noffsets\\\\n[\\\\ni\\\\n],\\\\nrecvbuffs\\\\n[\\\\ng\\\\n]\\\\n+\\\\noffsets\\\\n[\\\\ni\\\\n],\\\\ncounts\\\\n[\\\\ni\\\\n],\\\\ndatatype\\\\n[\\\\ni\\\\n],\\\\ncomms\\\\n[\\\\ng\\\\n],\\\\nstreams\\\\n[\\\\ng\\\\n]);\\\\n}\\\\nncclGroupEnd\\\\n();\\\\n}\\\\nncclGroupEnd\\\\n();\\\\nNote: The NCCL operation will only be started as a whole during the last call to ncclGroupEnd. form a complete collective operation.\\\\nFailure to do so will result in undefined behavior, including hangs, crashes, or data corruption.\\\\nAllReduce\\\\n¶\\\\nThe AllReduce operation performs reductions on data (for example, sum, min, max) across devices and stores the result in the receive buffer of every rank.\\\\nIn a\\\\nsum\\\\nallreduce operation between\\\\nk\\\\nranks, each rank will provide an array in of N values, and receive identical results in array out of N values,\\\\nwhere out[i] = in0[i]+in1[i]+…+in(k-1)[i].\\\\nAll-Reduce operation: each rank receives the reduction of input values across ranks.\\\\nRelated links:\\\\nncclAllReduce()\\\\n.\\\\nBroadcast\\\\n¶\\\\nThe Broadcast operation copies an N-element buffer from the root rank to all the ranks.\\\\nBroadcast mapping.\\\\nRelated links:\\\\nncclBroadcast()\\\\n.\\\\nReduce\\\\n¶\\\\nThe Reduce operation performs the same operation as AllReduce, but stores the result only in the receive buffer of a specified root rank.\\\\nReduce operation: one rank receives the reduction of input values across ranks.\\\\nImportant note: The root argument is one of the ranks (not a device number), and is therefore impacted by a different rank to device mapping.\\\\nNote: A Reduce, followed by a Broadcast, is equivalent to the AllReduce operation.\\\\nRelated links:\\\\nncclReduce()\\\\n.\\\\nAllGather\\\\n¶\\\\nThe AllGather operation gathers N values from k ranks into an output buffer of size k*N, and distributes that result to all ranks.\\\\nThe output is ordered by the rank index. ranks.\\\\nNote: Executing ReduceScatter, followed by AllGather, is equivalent to the AllReduce operation.\\\\nRelated links:\\\\nncclAllGather()\\\\n.\\\\nReduceScatter\\\\n¶\\\\nThe ReduceScatter
